title: Appointment Setter & Lead Nurture Specialist
description:
ABOUT US



Vantage College Recruiting helps high school basketball players in the United States earn college basketball offers. Families find us through our Instagram ads and book a call with our owner to map out their son's or daughter's recruiting plan.



We are a small, growing company. You will work directly with the owner, Jackson, and your work will have a direct, visible impact on how many families we help.



THE JOB



You own everything that happens between a new lead coming in and a family showing up prepared for their call with Jackson.



Leads come in two ways:



Families who booked a call themselves. Your job is to nurture them before the call:

Collect the athlete's highlight film and key information: graduation year, position, height, school, GPA, and current recruiting situation

Share helpful recruiting information that we provide, so the family understands the process and the value of the call

Confirm the call, send reminders (day before, morning of, one hour before), and make sure both parents who need to be there are on it

If a family doesn't show up, contact them the same day and rebook them

Families who opted in but did not book. Your job is to start a real conversation, check whether they are a good fit, and book the call:

Respond fast. Speed matters: new leads get a personal reply within 5 minutes during your shift

Qualify before you book: the athlete plays competitive high school or AAU basketball, film is available, the graduation year fits what we work with, and a parent who makes decisions will be on the call

If a family is not a fit, let them down politely and point them in a helpful direction

When lead flow is quiet, you will work our list of older leads who never booked, and do outreach on Instagram to start new conversations and book calls.



Every day:



Keep every conversation, note, and athlete detail organized in our CRM (GoHighLevel). If it is not in the CRM, it did not happen

Send a short end-of-day report: new leads, conversations started, calls booked, calls that showed, film/info packets completed

One rule that matters: you never evaluate a player, predict scholarship chances, or promise recruiting results. You collect information, educate with materials we give you, and book calls. All evaluations happen on the call with Jackson.



HOURS AND PAY



Full-time, Monday to Friday, 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM US Central Time (3:00 AM to 11:00 AM Philippine Time)

$600/month base salary, paid twice a month via Wise

$25 for every qualified appointment that shows up with the athlete's film and information collected in advance

5% commission on cash collected from clients who sign up from calls you set or nurtured, paid when their payment clears (refunded payments are deducted)

Strong performers earn $1,100 to $1,400/month in total

Pro-rated 13th-month bonus

This starts with a paid 2-week trial. If it goes well, it becomes a long-term full-time role

WHAT YOU NEED



At least 1 year of experience as an appointment setter, lead nurture specialist, or a similar role for a US-based business. Experience with coaching, agency, or high-ticket offers is a strong plus

Excellent written English. Most of this job is texting with American parents, and your writing is the first impression of our company

Strong spoken English for occasional phone calls

Experience with GoHighLevel or a similar CRM

Comfortable working inside Instagram and

Reliable internet with a backup connection, a quiet workspace, and a working headset

You are detail-obsessed and organized. Families trust us with their information and their kid's future, and we take that seriously

HOW TO APPLY



Follow these steps exactly. Applications that skip a step will not be read.



Start your application with the word TIPOFF so we know you read the full post

Attach a voice recording of about 60 seconds introducing yourself and explaining why you are good at this kind of work

Answer this in writing: a parent filled out our form yesterday but did not book a call. Write the first text message you would send them

Share your numbers from your last setter role: appointments set per month, and your show rate if you know it

We are looking for someone who wants to stay and grow with us, not a short-term gig. If that is you, we look forward to your application.

title: Real Estate Acquisitions VA / Junior Acquisitions Manager | Full-Time + Bonuses
description:
Big Bear Homebuyers is hiring a Real Estate Acquisitions VA / Junior Acquisitions Manager who can help us turn leads into signed contracts.



This is not a generic VA role and it is not just a cold-calling position. The role will be a mix of outbound prospecting and handling inbound seller leads, so you must be comfortable starting conversations as well as responding quickly to homeowners who contact us. You must have previous U.S. real estate wholesaling or acquisitions experience and understand how a deal moves from the first seller conversation to a signed purchase agreement.



THE ROLE



You will be expected to take leads through the full acquisitions process:



Inbound or outbound lead → qualify seller → comp property → negotiate → make offer → follow up → signed contract



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Make high-volume outbound calls to homeowners and real estate leads

• Respond promptly to inbound calls, texts, and leads from motivated sellers

• Work both inbound and outbound opportunities through the full acquisitions process

• Speak directly with motivated sellers and build real rapport

• Qualify motivation, timeline, property condition, and asking price

• Comp properties using recent comparable sales

• Determine ARV and estimate repairs

• Understand investor pricing and calculate an appropriate offer

• Negotiate price with homeowners

• Make offers and follow up consistently by phone and SMS

• Send purchase agreements and guide sellers through signing

• Keep every lead and conversation organized in our CRM

• Hit clear activity, follow-up, offer, and signed-contract targets



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• Previous U.S. real estate wholesaling or acquisitions experience is required

• You have personally comped properties and know how to determine ARV

• You understand repairs, investor pricing, and how to calculate a realistic offer

• You have personally spoken with motivated sellers and negotiated price

• You have experience following up with leads until they make a decision

• You know how to send a purchase agreement and get it signed

• Strong spoken and written English

• You sound natural, confident, and conversational on the phone — no robotic or cheesy sales scripts

• You are reliable, organized, coachable, and accountable



You must be comfortable handling both inbound and outbound seller conversations. High-volume outbound calling experience is strongly preferred. GoHighLevel experience is a plus.



WHO WILL DO WELL HERE



You are comfortable owning a lead instead of simply passing it along. You ask smart questions, think through the numbers, handle objections, make reasonable offers, and keep following up. You care about results and want to help get properties under contract.



If your background is only general virtual assistant work and you have not worked in U.S. real estate wholesaling or acquisitions, this role is not a fit.



COMPENSATION



• $600 USD per month base salary

• Uncapped performance bonuses

• Opportunities to earn bonuses based on qualified opportunities and signed or closed deals

• Compensation and responsibility can increase as you prove your results



Strong performers can earn significantly more than the base salary. This is intended to become a stable, long-term role for the right person.



SCHEDULE



This is a full-time position working primarily during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



YOU MUST HAVE



• Reliable high-speed internet

• A quiet, professional workspace

• A quality headset

• A backup internet and power solution strongly preferred



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer every question below. Generic applications or applications without the requested voice recording will not be considered.



1. How many years of U.S. real estate wholesaling or acquisitions experience do you have?

2. Have you personally comped properties before? Explain how you determine ARV.

3. Tell me about a recent property you helped get under contract. What was the ARV, seller asking price, offer price, and final contract price?

4. Have you personally negotiated price with homeowners?

5. Have you ever sent a purchase agreement and gotten it signed by a seller?

6. What CRM and real estate tools have you used?

7. Please send a short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your real estate acquisitions experience.



Please also include your resume and expected monthly salary in USD.



We are looking for someone who can help us get properties under contract — not someone who only wants to make calls.

title: Medical Billing & Administrative Virtual Assistant (Ophthalmology)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

A growing physician-led ophthalmology practice based in New Jersey, USA. We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and dependable Medical Billing & Administrative Virtual.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in U.S. medical billing, insurance claims management, denial resolution, payment posting, and prior authorizations, in addition to excellent patient communication skills.

Medical billing and revenue cycle management will remain the primary responsibilities of this position, with additional telephone and administrative coverage during designated clinical days.

We are looking for a proactive professional who takes ownership of their responsibilities and is interested in establishing a long-term working relationship with our growing practice.

Previous experience in ophthalmology is highly preferred.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle Management

• Submit, review, and follow up on medical insurance claims.

• Investigate denied, rejected, unpaid, and underpaid claims; handle corrections, resubmissions, and appeals.

• Monitor accounts receivable (A/R) and outstanding insurance balances.

• Post and reconcile insurance payments, ERAs, EOBs, contractual adjustments, and approved write-offs.

• Prepare and follow up on medication, procedure, and surgical prior authorizations using CoverMyMeds and insurance portals.

• Maintain accurate billing records and provide regular updates on outstanding claims, denials, and authorizations.

• Identify billing discrepancies and coordinate with the physician when clarification or approval is needed.

Patient Communication & Administrative Support

• Answer incoming patient calls and return missed calls through RingCentral.

• Assist with appointment scheduling, cancellations, and rescheduling.

• Address routine billing, insurance, and administrative inquiries.

• Verify insurance eligibility, copayments, deductibles, and benefits as needed.

• Document patient communications and assist with other administrative tasks as assigned.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Minimum 1–2 years of hands-on U.S. medical billing experience.

• Experience with claims submission, denial management, payment posting, and accounts receivable.

• Experience with medication and procedure prior authorizations.

• Knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurance, CPT, ICD-10-CM, and billing modifiers.

• Familiarity with EHR/practice management systems, clearinghouses, and insurance portals.

• Excellent written and spoken English with professional telephone communication skills.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently.

• Understanding of HIPAA and willingness to sign required confidentiality and compliance agreements.

• Willingness to sign applicable confidentiality agreements, HIPAA-related documents, and a Business Associate Agreement (BAA), if required.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Ophthalmology billing experience, including ophthalmic procedures and surgeries.

• Experience with ModMed EMA/PM.

• Familiarity with TriZetto, Availity, CoverMyMeds, and RingCentral.

• Experience with New Jersey insurance plans.

• Medical billing or coding certification (CPC, CPB, or equivalent) is a plus.



WORK REQUIREMENTS

• Full-time remote position: 40 hours per week.

• Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (EST/EDT).

• Potential for additional hours as the practice grows.

• Quiet, private, and secure workspace with a reliable computer, high-speed internet, headset, and backup internet.

• Willingness to use time-tracking software and comply with HIPAA and practice security policies.

• Commitment to punctuality, professionalism, accuracy, and long-term employment.



HOW TO APPLY

Please click Apply and
 your resume to 

 Subject: Medical Billing VA 2026 – [Your Full Name]

Briefly describe your medical billing experience, and familiarity with payer systems.

When applying through OnlineJobs.ph, please use 6 Apply Points.

title: Virtual Assistant Talent Pool Waves 2, 3 and 4
description:
Video applications only. No CV needed. Medyo mahaba-haba ’to, so brace yourselves. 😄



Hi! We’re opening applications for Waves 2, 3, and 4 of our virtual assistant talent pool at our Florida-based agency. Whether you’ve been a VA for years or you’re just getting curious about VA life, we’d love to meet you and hear what kind of work you enjoy.



We review applications in waves and invite shortlisted applicants to a live screening. From there, we make client introductions when there’s an available assignment that fits your skills, schedule, and preferences.



Two ways to work with us:

- Direct placement. We introduce you to a client and help with the handoff. If you both d
 to move forward, you and the client agree on the work, schedule, and pay before you start. Before we hand you off, the client is your point of contact for day-to-day questions, schedule changes, and payments.  

- Agency-managed. You support a client through our agency. We handle your payments, and you’ll have an account manager for check-ins, coaching, and support. If a client stops responding, treats you poorly, or the assignment feels like a poor fit, you can reach out to us. We’ll help you work through it and support you through the transition if the assignment needs to end.



What to share in your video:

Speak in your own words without reading from a script or notes. Imagine we’re already on a call getting to know each other.  



1. Tell us a little about yourself. What does a typical day look like for you? What kind of work do you enjoy, and what are you looking for right now?



2. Share your availability. Which shift can you comfortably commit to each week, 9 AM–1 PM ET (part-time) or 9 AM–5 PM ET (full-time)? When could you start? If you have commitments during your preferred shift, let us know which days and times. You’re welcome to work with other clients as long as the hours you commit to this assignment are set aside for it. Pick a schedule that leaves you enough time to rest, too.



3. Tell us about your workspace and backup plans. What equipment and internet connection do you use? If your Wi-Fi d
 to take the day off, the power goes out, or your computer stops working mid-shift, what’s your plan? Tell us what backups you already have, how quickly you could get back to work, and how you’d let the client or our team know. If you’re still setting something up, just tell us where you’re at with it.



4. Tell us what kind of work and clients suit you. If you’ve worked as a VA before, share one or two types of clients you feel most confident supporting and up to two types of clients or working arrangements you’d rather pass on next time. You’re welcome to tell us why, and you can keep client names private. Then tell us about one of your longest client engagements, how long you worked with them, and one task you handled yourself. Walk us through it from start to finish. Pick something you know well enough to do on your own, even without AI.



New to VA work? You’re welcome to apply! 

What sparked your interest? Maybe a friend told you about it, you saw it on TV, or you were ready for a change from your usual 9-to-5. Tell us what work you’d like to try and share one task you handled at a previous job, at school, while volunteering, or on a personal project. You can also answer this scenario. A customer asks if their appointment is still on for tomorrow, but you can’t find their name on the calendar. What would you check first, and what would you tell them while you look into it?



5. Tell us which setup you prefer. Direct placement, agency-managed, or open to both? If you’re still figuring it out, that’s okay. Tell us what you’re curious about, and we’ll be happy to talk it through with you.



6. Share your thoughts on brief video check-ins. For agency-managed assignments, your account manager or a team member may occasionally hop on a quick live video call during your shift to confirm you’re personally handling the work and see how things are going. It’s also a chance to ask for help if you’re stuck. How do you feel about that, and what kind of support helps you do your best work?



7. Tell us your expected hourly rate in USD.



8. One last question, just for fun. What’s a plot twist in your life you never saw coming? It can be funny, wild, fun fact.. or as simple as 

“I used to champion in singing contest since grade school hanggang ngayon na may mga apo narin...” 

or "I have Bachelor's degree and all pero pucha, hindi pala sapat, kaylangang humarbat para sa kinabukasan walang katapusan".. 

or "I used to worked sa wet market ng tatay ko... okay naman pero I want to give the best life for them too"

or "I'm a balot vendor, but as you can see, I know I can speak confidently and all and I'm positive I have the chance to work as VA.. sakit na sa lalamunan kaka sigaw ng balot sa gabi mem/serrr" 

... Kahit ano go!  Just share whatever you’re comfortable with.  



Screening and submission:

If you’re shortlisted for either setup, you’ll hear from (Jhon, our VA Scout, or Chi, our agency owner), to schedule a live screening before we introduce you to a client. Please have a valid government-issued ID ready to show privately during the call. Keep your ID out of your application video.



Please apply as an independent freelancer. We accept individual applicants only, and you’ll need to personally handle any work you accept.



Send your video application to:  
 subject: VA Talent Pool Wave 2 3 4| Name | City



If you send a video link, please check that we can open it without requesting access.



Thanks for taking the time to introduce yourself. We’d love to hear from you!



Maraming salamat,

Jhon & Chi B.

title: Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist
description:
Growth Pathway to Sales Manager / Team Leader



Company: Staff Connect (on behalf of our client)

Location: Remote – Philippines-based

Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)



Compensation: Performance-based earning opportunity ranging from PHP 30,000 to PHP 100,000+ per month, depending on individual sales performance. This role offers a competitive compensation structure with commissions and performance incentives that reward high achievers.



Schedule: Rotating 10-hour shifts across AEST business hours, with approximately 3–4 shifts rostered per week.



Leave: One week paid leave per year.



About the Client



Our client is Australia's leading misfuelling specialist, providing nationwide roadside assistance to motorists who a
 put the wrong fuel in their vehicle.



Their team supports customers during stressful situations by delivering fast, professional, and empathetic service while coordinating technicians across Australia.



Staff Connect is partnering with the client to build and expand their offshore operations team in the Philippines, creating long-term career opportunities for motivated individuals with leadership potential.



The Opportunity

Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Career Progression to Sales Manager / Team Leader



This is a fast-paced, customer-focused sales role centred on converting inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings while delivering exceptional customer support.



You will manage inbound roadside assistance calls, coordinate technicians nationwide, and ensure urgent jobs are handled efficiently from start to finish.



This role is best suited to candidates with previous roadside assistance, emergency dispatch, towing, transport coordination, or high-volume dispatching experience, as the environment requires excellent multitasking skills, urgency, and confidence in managing time-sensitive situations.



Team members who consistently achieve strong sales results and operational excellence will have opportunities for career progression into leadership positions and may eventually help manage the offshore team.



Performance Expectations

Successful candidates will be expected to:



- Achieve a minimum of 35 confirmed jobs sold per month

- Maintain strong inbound conversion rates

- Deliver exceptional customer service under pressure

- Efficiently coordinate and manage live dispatch operations

- Accurately handle bookings, job updates, and technician coordination

- Maximise every inbound sales opportunity



This role is ideal for individuals who are confident in sales, highly organised, calm under pressure, and experienced in fast-paced dispatch environments.



Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales & Customer Service

- Handle inbound calls from customers requiring urgent roadside assistance

- Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through confident communication and objection handling

- Deliver calm, empathetic, and professional customer support

- Collect deposits and accurately record booking information

- Meet or exceed individual sales targets and performance KPIs



Dispatch & Operations Coordination

- Coordinate technicians across Australia using dispatch and booking platforms

- Monitor live jobs and technician availability in real time

- Manage cases from initial enquiry through to completion

- Communicate with customers and technicians via phone, Slack, Gmail, and SMS

- Prioritise urgent and high-pressure jobs efficiently



Quality Control & Administration

- Review jobs daily to ensure accurate completion and closure

- Identify missed opportunities, incomplete bookings, or operational issues

- Maintain accurate records in GeoOp and Xero

- Ensure ETAs, notes, discounts, and call outcomes are properly logged

- Support operational compliance and workflow accuracy



Process Improvement & Team Support

- Assist with updating templates, documents, and operational processes

- Participate in Slack huddles, training sessions, and coaching

- Support escalated customer concerns when required

- Contribute ideas to improve dispatch efficiency and customer experience

- Be comfortable participating in video meetings and team collaboration



What We're Looking For

Essential Requirements

- Minimum two (2) years' experience in:

- Roadside assistance dispatch

- Emergency or high-volume dispatch environments

- Strong understanding of fast-paced roadside assistance workflows and urgent customer situations

- Experience coordinating mobile technicians and managing live jobs in real time

- Ability to confidently explain services and convert inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings

- Strong communication and objection-handling skills

- Excellent attention to detail when managing bookings, ETAs, and customer updates

- Calm, professional, and solutions-focused under pressure

- Comfortable supporting customers dealing with vehicle misfuelling i
, including fuel extraction, fuel replacement, and vehicle testing services

- Proficient in Google Workspace, Gmail, and web-based dispatch systems

- Comfortable using Slack and participating in online meetings and huddles

- Reliable work-from-home setup with a stable internet connection



Highly Regarded

- Previous experience in:

- Misfuelling or fuel recovery services

- Automotive roadside assistance

- Mechanical or vehicle service coordination

- Knowledge of Australian roads and geography

- Experience supporting Australian customers or operations

- Leadership, coaching, or team mentoring experience



What's in It for You

- Fully remote work-from-home opportunity

- Performance-based earning opportunity ranging from PHP 30,000 to PHP 120,000+ per month

- Commission and incentive structure that rewards strong sales performance

- Clear career progression pathway into leadership roles

- Ongoing training and professional development

- Opportunity to work with a growing international team

- Supportive and collaborative work environment

- Long-term career growth for high-performing team members

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Presidential Group | Perth, WA (Remote) | Full-Time Contract | Immediate Start



About the Role



Presidential Group is a well-established and growing business group based in Perth, Western Australia, operating across multiple industries including construction, facilities management, cabinetry and joinery, and hospitality. We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Manager based in the Philippines to join our team on a full-time contractor basis, working directly with our Managing Director.



This is a remote role suited to a self-directed professional who can hit the ground running. We are not in a position to provide training on core tools — you will be expected to bring proven, hands-on expertise from day one.



Please only apply if you can demonstrate measurable results across GoHighLevel, paid advertising, and graphic design.



Key Responsibilities



Build, manage, and optimise automation workflows, pipelines, funnels, and CRM configurations in GoHighLevel (GHL)

Set up and manage paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads and Meta 
/Instagram), with a focus on performance and return on investment



Design graphics and visual assets for ads, social media, and marketing collateral across multiple brands

Monitor campaign performance and provide regular, data-driven reports



Maintain consistent brand presentation across all digital channels for each entity within the group



Work independently and proactively, managing your own workload with minimal supervision



Required Skills and Experience



GoHighLevel (GHL)



Minimum 2 years of hands-on GHL experience



Demonstrated proficiency in automation workflows, pipeline management, funnel builds, and CRM configuration



Portfolio or screenshots of GHL builds required with your application



Paid Advertising



Minimum 2 years managing Google Ads and/or Meta Ads campaigns



Must provide examples of campaigns managed, including budgets, results, and key metrics (ROAS, CPL, or equivalent)



Experience with Australian clients or markets is an advantage



Graphic Design



Proficient in Canva and/or Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator)

Design portfolio required, including ad creatives, social media graphics, and brand assets



The Person We Are Looking For



Skills get you the interview. Personality gets you the role.



We have worked with remote team members before and we know the difference between someone who just completes tasks and someone who genuinely shows up for the team. We are looking for the latter.



You are the right person if you:



Take ownership without being asked. You do not wait to be told what needs doing. You see a gap, you fill it, and you report back.



Communicate proactively. If something is delayed, unclear, or going wrong, you say so early — not after the deadline has passed. No surprises.



Bring a positive attitude, consistently. Not just when things are easy. You stay solution-focused under pressure and do not let setbacks derail your output.



Are genuinely adaptable. We operate across multiple industries and brands. Priorities shift. You adjust without friction and without needing to be managed through it.



Have a growth mindset. You are curious, you stay across what is changing in digital marketing, and you bring ideas to the table rather than waiting to be directed.



Are honest and direct. We value straight communication. If you do not know something, say so. If you disagree, say so professionally. We would rather have that conversation than deal with avoidable mistakes.

Take pride in your work. Every asset you produce, every campaign you run, every report you send represents Presidential Group. You hold yourself to a high standard because you care about the outcome, not just the task.

This role is a long-term engagement for the right person. We pay well, we treat our team with respect, and we expect the same in return.



You Will Be a Strong Fit If You



Are based in the Philippines and available to start immediately

Bring a positive, can-do attitude and maintain it under pressure

Are highly adaptable and comfortable shifting priorities across multiple brands and industries

Work well independently, take full ownership of your output, and require minimal supervision

Communicate clearly and proactively in English

Are available during Perth business hours (AWST, UTC+8)

Have a reliable internet connection and your own equipment

Are comfortable using time-tracking software



What We Offer



Above-market remuneration: USD $1,500 – $2,500 per month, based on experience and demonstrated results

Immediate start for the right candidate

Full-time contractor engagement (Monday to Friday, Perth time)

Direct working relationship with the Managing Director

Stable, long-term engagement with a growing, multi-entity Australian business group

Consistent hours and reliable payment



How to Apply



We are moving quickly and will contact shortlisted candidates within 24 to 48 hours. Please include the following with your application:



Updated resume or CV

GHL portfolio — screenshots or recordings of automation builds, pipelines, or funnels

Paid advertising examples — campaign results, ad screenshots, or case studies

Graphic design portfolio — minimum 5 samples

Cover letter (up to 200 words) explaining why you are the right fit for this role

A short video introduction covering your experience, approach, and why this role interests you

title: Content Marketing & Growth Specialist (Short-Form Video Focus)
description:
# Content Marketing & Growth Specialist (Short-Form Video Focus)



**Salary:** $6 USD/hour, depending on experience  

**Hours:** 40 hours/week  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines



## About the Role



We're a US-based company operating several online businesses across finance, professional education, career development, and consumer services.



We're looking for someone who combines **strong short-form video production skills with an understanding of organic content marketing and audience growth.**



You must be able to independently create engaging, professional-quality Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts, particularly **faceless videos using AI-generated visuals, voiceovers, stock footage, animations, and creative editing.**



We don't just want someone who understands content marketing strategy. We need someone who can actually **produce great content from concept to finished product** and understands how to use that content to generate organic traffic.



## What Your Typical Week Looks Like



Each week, you'll focus on a few of our brands, reviewing content performance, researching competitors and trends, and identifying opportunities for organic traffic growth.



You'll then plan, create, and publish content, primarily:



- **Short-form videos (primary focus):** Script, produce, edit, and distribute engaging Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts, including faceless and AI-assisted videos.

- **Carousels:** Create engaging, educational, and visually appealing posts.

- **Blog posts:** Occasionally write articles supporting our broader content marketing strategy.



You'll also track performance, identify what's working, and refine your approach to increase reach, engagement, and website traffic.



We encourage heavy use of AI tools to streamline production, but **the final content must look polished, professional, and engaging. We'll reimburse you for all necessary tools.**



## What We're Looking For



- **Strong video editing and production skills are essential.** You must have a portfolio of short-form videos you've personally created.

- Experience producing faceless videos using AI tools, stock footage, voiceovers, and motion graphics.

- Ability to develop compelling hooks, scripts, pacing, captions, and visuals that keep viewers watching.

- Strong understanding of organic content marketing, content distribution, and traffic generation.

- Experience creating carousel posts and other visual content.

- Excellent written English, creativity, and ability to work independently.

- Analytical mindset with a focus on generating real traffic and results.



## Other Details



- 40 hours per week.

- Required working hours: 8 AM–1 PM Eastern Time, with flexible hours for the remaining time.



## Why Join Us?



- Long-term, full-time opportunity (40 hours/week).

- Creative freedom to experiment with content formats and AI tools.

- Work across multiple growing online businesses without the rigor of individual client requests.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. An introduction video with quick highlights of your recent content marketing experience.

2. Links to 3–5 short-form videos you've personally produced and edited**, preferably including faceless or AI-assisted videos.

3. Examples of brands or content marketing campaigns you've helped grow, including measurable results.

title: Aged Care Rostering Support Co-ordinator (NDIS / Aged Care Industry)
description:

coordinating and rostering approved participant services, maintaining accurate records, managing

workflow follow up, and escalating issues where needed. The role is designed to support the Senior Care

Partner team by ensuring day to day care administration is actioned accurately, efficiently, and in line

activities of daily living delivering quality care management services through the Support at Home

program for our aged care participants. Working closely with participants, families and various health

professionals you ensure services reflect each participant's assessed needs, preferences and available

funding.



The ideal candidate has very strong English speaking and writing skills. You are proactive, have high

7. Ongoing Care Support

• Support participant goals and independence focused service delivery



8. Review and Administrative Support

• Prepare supporting documents for support plan or service reviews when required

• Compile current services, budget usage, and care notes

• Maintain trackers, reports, and workflow systems

• Support audit preparation and internal administration



Qualifications

• Minimum 2+ years working with Australian Aged Care, NDIS or Allied Health industry

• Diploma or tertiary level qualification in Community Services, Aged Care, Case Management

• Experience in care partner administration, scheduling / rostering, healthcare or NDIS support

• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with people at all levels.

• Excellent written and spoken English skills.

• Experience in Xero accounting (desirable)

• Reliable, proactive, and detail-oriented with solid multi-tasking skills.

• Knowledge of home care regulations, industry standards, and best practices.

• High attention to detail and data accuracy

• Ability to follow structured workflows, prioritise work and meet deadlines

Experience in one or more of the following will be highly regarded:

title: Cost Accountant
description:
**MUST BE AVAILABLE TO START ASAP WITH NO CURRENT EMPLOYMENT OR OTHER ENGAGEMENTS.**



We are seeking an experienced Cost Accountant to oversee manufacturing-related accounting activities, support financial operations, and ensure accurate cost reporting, inventory valuation, and financial performance analysis.



The role combines hands-on financial accounting, manufacturing cost management, cash flow forecasting, internal controls, and financial process improvement. The successful candidate will work closely with finance leadership and operational teams to maintain accurate financial records, strengthen accounting processes, and support business decisions.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Manufacturing & Cost Accounting

- Manage standard costing, including direct materials, labor, and manufacturing overhead.

- Analyze production variances, purchase price variances, and manufacturing efficiency.

- Monitor inventory valuation, cost of goods sold (COGS), and gross margin performance.

- Review inventory reserves, obsolete stock, scrap, and inventory adjustments.

- Coordinate inventory reconciliations, cycle counts, and year-end inventory procedures.

- Support product profitability and manufacturing cost optimization.



2. Financial Accounting & Reporting

- Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end accounting activities.

- Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.

- Analyze financial statements, operating expenses, and profitability.

- Maintain accurate general ledger records and financial reporting schedules.

- Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and internal policies.



3. Cash Flow & Financial Management

- Prepare rolling 13-week cash flow forecasts and regular cash reports.

- Monitor working capital, operating expenditures, and financial commitments.

- Analyze actual financial results against budgets and forecasts.

- Identify financial risks and recommend corrective actions.



4. Financial Operations & Internal Controls

- Develop and improve accounting policies, procedures, and financial controls.

- Support chart of accounts management and ERP reporting improvements.

- Maintain fixed asset records, depreciation schedules, and capital expenditure reporting.

- Ensure appropriate transaction approvals, documentation, and segregation of duties.



5. Business Transition & Financial Projects

- Support accounting transitions, financial data migration, and systems integration.

- Assist with opening balance sheets, historical financial reviews, and account mapping.

- Participate in post-acquisition accounting activities and finance transformation projects.

- Coordinate accounting deliverables with internal stakeholders and external advisers.



Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in Accountancy

- CPA qualification required.

- At least 5-7 of accounting experience, including manufacturing or cost accounting.

- Strong knowledge of standard costing, inventory accounting, and variance analysis.

- Experience in month-end close, financial reporting, and balance sheet reconciliations.

- Experience with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, NetSuite, SAP, or equivalent.

- Advanced Excel skills, including financial analysis, modeling, and reporting.

- Working knowledge of US GAAP and financial control procedures.

- Strong communication and cross-functional coordination skills.



Work Arrangement & Benefits:

- Work Setup: 100% remote / Work-from-Home (WFH)

- Employment Type: Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Work Schedule: US business hours

- 13th Month Pay: Provided annually

- Health Benefits: HMO coverage

- Salary: NO salary deductions; full agreed compensation will be received

title: General Program Manager

We are seeking a dynamic and talented General Program Manager to join our team. This role is perfect for a highly intelligent, motivated individual who is passionate about leveraging technology to make a difference in healthcare.

AnsibleHealth is a US medical group for people living with serious heart and lung disease, such as heart failure and COPD. Health systems and health plans send us their patients, often right after a hospital stay. Our own doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses and respiratory therapists then look after them at home by video and phone: we adjust medicines, treat flare-ups early, teach patients and their families, and are on call day and night. The goal is fewer trips back to the hospital. We were founded in 2021, are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital and AlleyCorp, and our team works across the United States and the Philippines.



The Job at a Glance

We're seeking a super smart, hungry, and resilient individual who is passionate about technology and healthcare to join us as a Program Manager. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and brings a strong organizational mindset to complex projects. You will be responsible for overseeing multiple complex programs across various departments to ensure successful delivery within scope, timeline, and budget. This role requires a self-motivated individual who can work independently and adapt to the dynamic nature of a growing startup in the healthcare technology space.

- Continuously identify and mitigate program risks and issues.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders to drive program success and identify growth opportunities.

- Anticipate issues, propose solutions, manage dependencies, and identify areas for tool/process improvement.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable to be in a constantly changing role with a high level of ambiguity - as we are a fast-moving startup operating in an ever-evolving environment. He or she should have excellent analytical, communication and management skills to succeed in this role.



Education

Bachelor's degree from one of the top five universities in the Philippines.



Required Qualifications and competencies

- Fresh graduates are welcome to apply; 0-5 years of relevant work experience is an advantage but not required.

- Demonstrated passion for technology and ability to quickly adapt to new digital tools and platforms.

- Exceptional organizational skills.

- Resilient mindset with the ability to bounce back from challenges and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

- Keen interest in healthcare and improving patient outcomes; prior healthcare experience is a plus but not mandatory.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think critically and creatively.

- Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity in a startup environment.

- Eagerness to take on leadership roles and initiative to drive projects forward.

- Ability to influence and collaborate with stakeholders at all levels.

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.

- Enthusiasm for continuous learning and process improvement.



The ideal candidate is a highly intelligent, motivated individual who is passionate about leveraging technology to make a difference in healthcare. title: Experienced Third-Party Debt Collector | U.S. Accounts | Remote Philippines
description:
Company: Live Oak Financial, Inc.

Location: Remote - Philippines

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time; Philippine night shift, following U.S. daylight saving time

Compensation: $5/hour plus performance-based commission under the written compensation plan



Bring your collections experience to a role focused on personal results, sound judgment, and professional consumer communication.



Live Oak Financial is hiring experienced collectors who have personally recovered delinquent U.S. accounts for third-party collection agencies. We are particularly interested in candidates with medical, utility, or commercial collections experience.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Handle outbound and inbound collection calls for accounts placed by external creditors.

- Understand consumers' circumstances, address objections, and negotiate payment arrangements within approved guidelines.

- Follow up on commitments and maintain accurate account notes.

- Recognize disputes and other matters requiring escalation.

- Work toward individual recovery targets while meeting quality, privacy, and compliance requirements.

- Use collection software, dialers, and payment workflows accurately.



WHAT YOU BRING

- Demonstrated hands-on experience collecting U.S. accounts for a third-party agency.

- Strong spoken and written English, active listening, and confident negotiation skills.

- The ability to explain your individual collection results and performance against quota.

- Practical understanding of compliant U.S. collection communication.

- Reliable attendance, accurate documentation, and the ability to work independently.

- A suitable computer, headset, stable internet, and a quiet workspace.



First-party collections, customer service, medical billing, debt-settlement enrollment, or VA experience alone does not meet this role's requirements. Candidates with mixed backgrounds are welcome when they can demonstrate qualifying third-party agency work.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through this posting with your current resume and brief answers:

1. Which third-party agencies employed you, during what dates, and which U.S. debt types did you personally collect?

2. Describe your responsibilities for calls, payment negotiations, follow-up, and account documentation.

3. Provide your most recent available three months of individual collections and quota attainment. Distinguish gross payments from agency-fee revenue and personal results from team totals.

4. Briefly describe a difficult account you resolved professionally.

5. Confirm your Philippine location, schedule availability, expected hourly rate, and earliest start date.

Students get to see what the job actually looks like before they graduate.



The role:

You'll be the person who turns raw field footage into clean, ready-to-publish training videos. For each video you will:



1. Trim non-productive footage: long stretches of staring at walls/floors, walking down hallways, setting up equipment, silence or dead air. Keep everything where the pro is actually working or explaining something. When in doubt, keep it - students learn from the real pace of the work.

2. Blur the faces of everyone who appears in the videos (customers, homeowners, bystanders) to protect their privacy before anything is published.

3. Review and correct AI-generated captions so they exactly match what the pro says, including trade terminology.

4. Review and edit an AI-drafted overview and key-points summary for accuracy against the video.

5. Review a short 2-question knowledge-check quiz per video and fix or flag anything wrong or unclear.

6. Mark the video ready for final approval.



You'll work inside our own web-based review tool - no software to buy. We'll train you on our exact standards with examples. Right now the process is manual; over time our system will suggest cuts automatically and your job shifts more toward reviewing the suggestions.



Requirements:

- Excellent English comprehension - you must catch caption errors in spoken, accented, jobsite English with trade vocabulary

- Strong attention to detail; you're the last line of quality control before videos reach students

- Basic video editing experience (any tool - Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci, Descript), including how to blur or mask a moving face in footage

- Reliable internet capable of streaming and working with large video files

- Consistent weekly availability (10-20 hrs) and fast, clear communication



Nice to have: experience editing educational/tutorial content, familiarity with US trade work (HVAC, electrical, plumbing), experience reviewing AI-generated transcripts.



Paid test task (required):

Finalists will complete a paid test: review and trim 2 real field videos through our full process (trim, blur faces, captions, overview, quiz). Paid at your hourly rate regardless of outcome - typically 1-2 hours of work. This is the main way we choose, so do your best work.



To apply, answer these questions:

 what to cut vs. keep in footage that wasn't yours? How did you d
?

JL Marketing is a fast-growing Meta Badged Partner specializing in lead generation for health, wellness, and fitness businesses. We’re expanding our remote team and looking for a detail-oriented Meta Ads Virtual Assistant / Junior Media Buyer to support our marketing team.



This role is best for someone with experience in
 and Instagram ads who is organized, reliable, and comfortable handling campaign execution, monitoring, reporting, QA checks, and internal support.



We are only reviewing applications submitted through our website.



Role Overview



We’re looking for a dedicated Meta Ads Virtual Assistant / Junior Media Buyer to support the day-to-day execution of our
 and Instagram ad campaigns. You’ll work closely with our Account Managers and marketing team on campaign setup, monitoring, reporting, tracking checks, creative coordination, and administrative tasks, while also sharing ideas and suggestions to help improve performance and processes.



Responsibilities



Meta Ads Support



* Assist in creating, launching, and monitoring
 and Instagram ad campaigns.

* Help with campaign updates and optimizations based on Account Manager direction and performance data.

* Assist with audience research, targeting setup, campaign objectives, budgets, and ad setup.

* Monitor key campaign metrics such as CPL, CTR, conversions, lead volume, and lead quality.

* Flag performance issues, unusual changes, or campaign errors to the team.



Campaign QA, Reporting & Tracking



* Check campaigns before and after launch to make sure ads, links, forms, budgets, creatives, and targeting are set up correctly.

* Monitor ad performance and prepare simple performance reports or updates for the team.

* Assist with Meta Pixel / Dataset checks, event tracking, and troubleshooting when needed.

* Help confirm lead flow, form submissions, CRM connections, and tracking accuracy.



Creative & Copy Coordination



* Coordinate ad creatives, copy, and assets with the marketing team.

* Help organize campaign assets, creative files, and client notes.

* Make sure ads are aligned with client branding, offers, and campaign goals.



Administrative & VA Support



* Maintain organized campaign files, client notes, and internal documentation.

* Assist with scheduling, team coordination, and project updates.

* Support CRM updates and communication tasks when needed.

* Join daily Zoom huddles and provide clear updates on assigned tasks.



Qualifications



Meta Ads Experience



* Experience managing or assisting with
 and Instagram ad campaigns.

* Basic understanding of Meta Ads Manager, campaign objectives, targeting, budgets, placements, ads, and reporting.

* Experience with lead generation campaigns is preferred.



Detail-Oriented & Organized



* Strong attention to detail.

* Able to manage multiple tasks efficiently.

* Comfortable checking work carefully before marking tasks complete.



Communication Skills



* Good written and verbal English communication skills.

* Comfortable collaborating with a remote team.

* Able to provide regular updates and flag issues quickly.



Self-Motivated & Reliable



* Able to work independently, follow instructions, and take initiative.

* Reliable, organized, and comfortable with repetitive but important execution tasks.

* Able to work effectively from home and align working hours closely with US time zones.



What We Offer



Flexible Remote Work

Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote position, allowing you to work from anywhere.



Growth Opportunities

Opportunity to grow within a fast-paced digital marketing agency and expand your skills in paid advertising, lead generation, tracking, and campaign execution.



Supportive Team Environment

Join a collaborative team that meets daily on Zoom, with regular huddles to align on goals, share updates, and improve processes.



How to Apply



Ready to join JL Marketing and help support winning
 and Instagram ad campaigns?



We are only reviewing applications submitted through our website.



To demonstrate your attention to detail, please start your answer to the final question on the application form with the word BLUE.



Please fill out our application here: 
/va-rockstar/



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Graphic designer for e-commerce brand (Meta ads experience required)
description:
Graphic designer with Meta ads experience



We run a small group of online businesses: an e-commerce brand selling premium kitchen accessories, plus a digital agency that manages Meta ads and websites for local clients. We're looking for one exceptional graphic designer to join us and take on the day-to-day design and Meta ads work across all of it.



This is not a Canva-templates job. You need to be a proper graphic designer first: strong layout, typography and colour, able to make something look premium without a template. On top of that you need hands-on experience inside Meta Ads Manager, because part of the role is setting up and posting ads, not just designing them.



What you'll be doing



Design



Static ad creative for Meta 
 and Instagram): feed, story, reel cover, carousel

 designs for Klaviyo campaigns and flows

Social media posts, stories and graphics for our own brand and for clients

General graphic design: website graphics, banners, print pieces, packaging inserts, one-off requests

Product and lifestyle imagery from our photo library



Meta ads



Setting up campaigns, ad sets and ads in Meta Ads Manager for our brand and for agency clients

Uploading creative, writing or adapting the primary text and headlines, and publishing ads

Keeping an eye on what's running, flagging ads that are fatiguing or failing, and suggesting what to test next

Keeping the creative library organised so we know what's been tested



Content



Writing short posts and captions to go with the designs

Turning a one-line brief into a finished post or ad that's ready to go live



What you need



At least 2 years as a graphic designer, with a portfolio that shows real design skill, not just templates

Experience designing for an e-commerce or DTC brand

Hands-on experience in Meta Ads Manager: you've built and published campaigns yourself and you know what CPM, CTR and CPA mean

Photoshop and Illustrator (or Affinity). Figma is a plus

Good written English. You'll be writing captions and ad copy, so it needs to read naturally

Able to work from a short brief and manage your own week without constant check-ins

Reliable internet and a few hours a day overlapping with Australian business hours (AEST)



Nice to have



Basic video editing in CapCut or similar: cutting short clips, adding captions and text, working with Instagram edit templates

Experience managing ads for more than one account or client at a time

Shopify experience



How we work



You'll work directly with the founder. You'll get a weekly list of priorities, access to our brand guides, asset libraries and ad accounts, and quick feedback. We care about good work going out on time, not hours logged.



How to apply



Send the following. Applications missing any of these won't be considered.



A link to your portfolio showing a range of design work, including at least 5 of the work you designed

A few lines on your Meta Ads Manager experience: which accounts you've worked in, what you did, and for how long

One social media post of your choice with the caption you'd write for it



Start your application with the word "Pineapple" so we know you read the whole listing.

title: Phone Sales Rep / Appointment Setter for US Stores (Full-Time, US Hours)
description:
Hello!



We are a fast-growing US sales agency, and we are hiring multiple full-time remote phone sales reps with clear, neutral English. Our company is growing rapidly, so there is room for several new callers on our team.



What You Will Do

You will call independent natural food stores in the US and offer the store buyer a free product placement. This is a friendly, soft-sell role, not pushy sales. Most calls last 3 to 4 minutes. On a typical calling day, our callers get 3 to 10 stores to say yes.



What We Need

- Neutral-accent spoken English that US store buyers understand easily. Your voice sample is how we check this.

- Phone experience with US customers is a plus, but not required. If you are talented and new to calling, please apply.

- A headset and a quiet room so you sound clear. Wired internet and a USB headset are preferred.

- Someone who wants a steady, long-term role and takes pride in doing it well.



Schedule (Required)

Monday to Friday, 10:00 pm to 6:00 am Philippine time (9:00 pm to 5:00 am from mid-March to early November). That is 9:00 am to 5:00 pm US Eastern time. We prefer full time. Strong callers who can only work 20 to 30 hours a week inside these hours are welcome to apply; tell us your availability.



Pay

$5 per hour plus $3 for every store that says yes. Our part-time callers have earned about $25 to $120 in bonuses per two-week pay period when calling consistently. Your rate rises to $6 per hour after you show strong performance and stay with us, usually 3 to 6 months. Paid every two weeks. Independent contractor.



Timeline and Paid Trial

We are interviewing now. Training starts in early December with three 3-hour paid trial shifts at $5 per hour. Calling starts in early 2027.



How to Apply

Include a short English voice sample with your application. One you already have is fine. Vocaroo is best (free, no sign-up). A Google Drive link, an audio file or a Loom video also works. Please turn on downloading so we can review it. We do not review applications without a voice sample.

title: Fast-Response Facebook Marketplace Car Deal Researcher
description:
I’m looking for a reliable assistant to monitor
 Marketplace for newly listed used-car deals. Good listings sell quickly, so you must check frequently during your scheduled work hours and notify me within 5 minutes of finding a promising listing.



What you’ll look for



* 2014 or newer Honda vehicles and Toyota Corollas

* Asking price under $5,000

* The listing price must be below Kelley Blue Book Fair Market Value for that specific vehicle



How to verify a deal



Before alerting me, compare the listing with KBB using the closest available match for year, model, trim, mileage, condition, and location. Don’t send listings that you can’t verify as below KBB value. For each qualifying deal, send me:



* Marketplace link and asking price

* Year, make, model, trim, and mileage

* KBB value used for comparison and the estimated difference

* Listing location and time posted, if shown

* Screenshots or other evidence supporting the comparison



Speed matters. Send the alert as soon as you verify the listing; don’t wait to compile a batch.



First-week accountability



During your first seven days, screen-record your scheduled work sessions while you perform Marketplace searches and KBB checks, then share the recordings with me. Record only the work screen during scheduled hours.



To apply



Please explain your experience with
 Marketplace and 
, what hours you can monitor listings, and how you would verify a deal quickly. Include one sample vehicle listing and show how you’d compare it with KBB.

title: AU Senior Tax Accountant
description:
**MUST BE AVAILABLE TO START ASAP WITH NO CURRENT EMPLOYMENT OR OTHER ENGAGEMENTS.**



ROLE SUMMARY:

Senior-level Australian public-practice role responsible for tax compliance, tax planning, financial analysis, and business advisory for SMEs.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Prepare and review financial statements and income tax returns for companies, trusts, partnerships, sole traders, and individuals.

- Prepare and review BAS and IAS, including GST and PAYG reconciliations.

- Review shareholder and related-party loan accounts and assess Division 7A, including complying loan arrangements, benchmark interest, minimum yearly repayments, distributable surplus, and deemed-dividend exposure.

- Prepare and review CGT calculations, including CGT events, capital proceeds, cost base, capital losses, discounts, concessions, and rollovers.

- Prepare and review FBT calculations and returns, including motor vehicles, entertainment, employee contributions, exemptions, reductions, and taxable values.

- Review trust taxable income, beneficiary entitlements, distribution resolutions, franking implications, and Division 7A considerations involving corporate beneficiaries.

- Prepare book-to-tax adjustments, tax reconciliations, franking-account reconciliations, and supporting tax workpapers.

- Perform quarterly tax planning using year-to-date results and projected full-year profitability.

- Calculate projected income-tax liabilities and assess PAYG instalments and upcoming tax cash requirements.

- Prepare budgets, forecasts, and cash-flow analysis for business advisory engagements.

- Analyse profitability, working capital, cash-flow constraints, financial trends, and business performance.

- Assist with business structuring, tax planning, technical taxation research, and written client advice.

- Handle technical client queries and ATO correspondence within delegated authority.

- Review accounting and taxation work prepared by other team members.

- Communicate directly with clients to request information, explain tax positions, discuss financial results, and provide practical commercial advice.

title: Client Case & Business Operations Coordinator
description:
ABOUT VLARI



VLARI is a specialized U.S.-based advisory firm serving established business owners. We work with a limited number of clients and prioritize quality, accuracy, confidentiality, and thoughtful service over high case volume.



We are seeking a reliable, highly organized Client Case & Business Operations Coordinator for a full-time, long-term position.



This is a versatile role for someone who enjoys managing detailed processes, communicating professionally with clients, organizing financial documents, and ensuring that every case continues moving forward.



This is not a sales, call-center, or independent advisory position. You will receive training in our internal processes. You will begin with client onboarding, administrative support, document organization, and case coordination. As you demonstrate proficiency, your responsibilities may expand into preliminary case preparation and implementation tracking.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



Once a client completes payment, you will become the client’s primary operational contact.



You will own the administrative journey from payment through completed onboarding and preparation of a review-ready client file.



You will make sure clients understand what is required, submit the appropriate documents, answer all required intake questions, receive timely updates, and progress through each stage of the engagement.



POST-PAYMENT CLIENT ONBOARDING



Your responsibilities will include:



* Sending welcome communications immediately after payment

* Explaining the onboarding process and next steps

* Providing access to the secure client portal

* Confirming completion of engagement documents and required acknowledgments

* Scheduling onboarding, review, and presentation meetings

* Guiding clients through intake questionnaires

* Asking approved follow-up questions when information is incomplete

* Providing and explaining the required-document checklist

* Collecting tax returns, financial statements, payroll records, entity documents, insurance information, investment statements, and other requested records

* Reviewing documents for completeness, legibility, correct reporting periods, and missing pages

* Comparing submitted documents against the client’s checklist

* Following up professionally for missing information

* Documenting the client’s objectives, concerns, priorities, and unanswered questions

* Entering and verifying information in company systems

* Maintaining accurate notes, tasks, deadlines, and pipeline stages

* Preparing a consolidated internal case summary

* Identifying inconsistencies and questions that require escalation

* Confirming when the client’s file is complete and ready for professional review

* Sending appropriate progress updates throughout the engagement

* Coordinating communication among the client, company leadership, and assigned professionals



CASE AND IMPLEMENTATION COORDINATION



After training, your responsibilities may also include:



* Organizing financial and business information for internal analysis

* Extracting designated information from financial statements and tax documents

* Preparing preliminary internal summaries for review

* Operating internal assessment and case-preparation systems

* Coordinating reviews with accountants, attorneys, insurance professionals, and other specialists

* Recording professional feedback and requested changes

* Preparing meeting briefs and client presentation materials

* Creating and maintaining implementation checklists

* Assigning and tracking approved implementation steps

* Following up with clients and outside professionals

* Assisting with insurance and annuity application processing

* Tracking applications, signatures, transfers, funding, and outstanding requirements

* Communicating with insurance carriers and related organizations

* Maintaining accurate case statuses until completion

* Escalating matters requiring professional judgment or approval



ADMINISTRATIVE AND BUSINESS OPERATIONS



Because VLARI serves a limited number of quality clients, this position will support several areas of the business. Additional responsibilities may include:



* Managing calendars and appointment confirmations

* Monitoring and organizing company email

* Answering and routing administrative client calls

* Drafting routine client communications

* Updating CRM records and pipeline stages

* Organizing company files and folders

* Maintaining standard operating procedures

* Auditing client files for missing information

* Assisting with basic bookkeeping and operational reporting

* Maintaining service and follow-up calendars

* Researching administrative information when assigned

* Testing intake forms, reports, and internal workflows

* Supporting special company projects during lower-volume periods



PROFESSIONAL BOUNDARIES



You will explain company processes, collect factual information, answer approved administrative questions, and coordinate work that has already been authorized.



You will not be expected or authorized to independently:



* Provide U.S. tax advice

* Provide legal advice

* Recommend investments, insurance policies, or annuities

* Approve client strategies

* Promise financial or tax results

* Represent yourself as a U.S.-licensed professional

* Release a final client design without approval



Any question involving professional judgment or a recommendation must be documented and escalated to the appropriate professional.



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Have an accounting, bookkeeping, business administration, insurance, or financial-services background

* Have experience supporting U.S. clients or companies

* Are comfortable reviewing financial documents

* Communicate clearly and professionally by email, telephone, and video

* Are highly organized and careful with details

* Follow instructions and documented procedures

* Can work independently without constant supervision

* Are comfortable performing both analytical and routine administrative work

* Know when to ask questions or escalate an issue

* Enjoy managing cases from beginning to completion

* Want a stable, long-term role with one company

* Respect confidentiality and sensitive client information

* Prefer quality and accuracy over high-volume, rushed work

* Are interested in growing within an organization rather than building a competing advisory practice



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Strong spoken and written English

* At least two years of relevant administrative, bookkeeping, accounting, insurance, client-service, or case-management experience

* Strong spreadsheet, email, and document-management skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Leadership Skills

* Managerial Skills

* Professional telephone presence

* Reliable computer and high-speed internet

* Quiet and professional environment for client calls

* Ability to handle confidential financial information

* Ability to organize multiple cases and deadlines

* Willingness to complete reference and background checks

* Willingness to sign confidentiality, data-security, and intellectual-property agreements

* Availability for scheduled overlap with U.S. Pacific Time



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:



* QuickBooks Online

* GoHighLevel or another CRM

* U.S. bookkeeping or accounting

* U.S. business financial statements

* U.S. business tax documents

* Client onboarding

* Life-insurance or annuity case processing

* Financial-advisor support

* Tax Strategies

* Project Manager

* Project Coordinator

* DocuSign or secure client portals

* Workflow and implementation tracking

* Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets



COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE



* 20-40 hours per week

* Initial 90-day evaluation period

* Compensation and responsibility review following successful completion of the evaluation period

* Long-term growth opportunity based on performance, accuracy, reliability, and judgment



HOW TO APPLY



Applications that do not follow all instructions will not be considered.



Please submit:



1. Your current résumé.

2. A link to a two-to-three-minute video introduction.

3. Complete written responses to the questions below.

4. The words “VLARI Case Coordinator” as the first line of your application.



Your video may be submitted using Loom, Google Drive, an unlisted YouTube video, or another accessible video-link service. Confirm that anyone with the link can view it.



IN YOUR VIDEO, PLEASE ADDRESS:



* Your name and current location

* Your most relevant professional experience

* The types of U.S. clients or companies you have supported

* Your experience with accounting, bookkeeping, client onboarding, insurance, or case management

* Why you are comfortable performing both administrative and analytical work

* How you communicate with a client who has not submitted required information

* Why you are interested in a long-term position



Please speak naturally. Do not simply read your résumé. Video-production quality is not important. We are evaluating your communication, professionalism, thought process, and ability to interact comfortably with clients.



WRITTEN APPLICATION QUESTIONS



1. Describe a situation in which you discovered missing or inaccurate information in a client file. What did you do?



2. How do you organize multiple clients, tasks, and deadlines?



3. What accounting, bookkeeping, CRM, project-management, and document-management systems have you used?



4. Describe your experience collecting information or documents from clients.



5. Are you comfortable making and receiving professional client calls? Please describe your experience.



6. How would you follow up with a client who has not responded to two document requests?



7. What would you do if a client asked you a technical question that you were not trained or authorized to answer?



8. Are you comfortable performing scheduling, email follow-up, data entry, file organization, and other administrative tasks while learning more advanced responsibilities?



9. Are you currently working for other clients? If so, describe your current schedule and availability.



10. What monthly compensation are you seeking?



11. Please provide two professional references.



SELECTION PROCESS



Qualified applicants may be invited to:



* Attend a video interview

* Complete a short paid assessment using fictional client information

* Draft a sample client email

* Review a sample file for missing information

* Prepare a brief internal case summary

* Participate in a mock client call



We are looking for someone who wants to become a dependable, trusted, and long-term member of VLARI.
