title: YouTube Scriptwriter — Strange Encounters & Compelling Mysteries
description:
We're looking for an excellent, independent writer to create compelling YouTube scripts about strange sightings, unusual encounters, and unexplained events.



THE STANDARD WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for a writer who can create scripts on the level of MrBallen and Lighthouse Mysteries. These two channels illustrate the storytelling standard we want: compelling stories, natural language, strong pacing, and details that keep you listening from beginning to end.



We want someone who can turn a fascinating mystery into a complete, engaging script. Someone who knows what to include, what to leave out, and how to make each part of the story interesting. The opening should draw listeners in, and the writing needs to hold their attention all the way to the ending.



We've been looking for the right writer for a while. The problems we keep encountering are repetition, boring stretches, unnatural wording, and scripts that need substantial rewriting before they can be narrated. We need the judgment and attention to detail to deliver polished work independently.



For the right writer, this could become a long-term role with regular assignments. We'd like to build an ongoing working relationship with someone whose scripts we're excited to read.



PAY & DETAILS



• $100 USD per script, including research.

• 3,000–3,600 words per script.

• Freelance position with potential for ongoing work.

• We provide the topic and writing guidelines for each assignment.



THE ROLE



For paid assignments, you will handle research, fact-checking, structure, writing, and proofreading independently. Each finished script needs to be ready to narrate as written, without us having to rewrite sentences, simplify the language, correct factual errors, or restructure the story.



Topics include strange sightings, unexplained events, and unusual encounters. No true crime. Stories should have safe outcomes for everyone involved.



THE WRITING



Scripts should be extremely easy to follow and natural when read aloud, as though you're telling a friend a fascinating story. We want a strong opening, events presented in a clear chronological order, and interesting details that hold attention throughout.



Plain language is essential. No flowery descriptions, elaborate metaphors, or sentences dressed up to sound impressive. For example:



• Instead of “An eerie silence draped itself over the sleepy town,” use “The town was quiet.”

• Instead of “The moon cast its silver veil across the lonely stretch of asphalt,” use “The moon lit the road.”

• Instead of “An icy wave of terror gripped him as he gazed upon the mysterious figure,” use “He was frightened when he saw the figure.”



No robotic phrasing, generic suspense lines, awkward transitions, repeated points, or padding. Build suspense through the events and details of the story.



Paid scripts must be carefully researched and include source links. Documented facts, witness accounts, and speculation should be presented accurately. Do not invent details or dialogue. Include pronunciation guides in parentheses for unfamiliar names and places.



TO APPLY



Use Ghost as the subject line and include:



1. A brief introduction and any relevant writing experience.

2. Your strongest existing script that demonstrates this level of storytelling. A complete script lets us see how you carry the story from its opening through to its ending. Identify exactly what you wrote and make sure the link is accessible.

3. Links to published videos using your writing, if available, and your role in creating them.

4. Your usual turnaround time for a 3,000–3,600-word script.



We're looking for a dependable writer with serious attention to detail and the ability to consistently deliver engaging, narration-ready scripts.

title: Actuarial and Risk Specialist
description:
About the role



I am is a solo actuarial, risk and regulatory consultancy based in Ireland, set up about six months ago. Most of your time will be spent developing advisory offers. AI governance is the first major piece of work. You’ll also support technical client projects from time to time, mainly behind the scenes.



You’ll work directly with me. I’ll give you the context, an initial steer and a clear outcome to aim for. From there, I’d expect you to get to grips with the topic quickly, pull together the relevant information, challenge assumptions and come back with a practical recommendation. I’ll lead the client relationship and retain final technical sign-off.



Main work: developing advisory offers:



The job is to turn a real client problem into an offer we can explain, scope and deliver. You’ll help work out who needs it, what decision they’re trying to make, what information we’d need, what checks we’d run and what the client would get back. You’ll then build the practical material behind the offer: diagnostic questions, checklists, templates, worked examples and a delivery playbook.



AI governance is the first priority. These are examples of the problems the offer needs to solve:



- AI is already in use, but no one has a reliable inventory. Help design an AI use-case register that records where AI is used, who owns it, what risks it creates and which uses need closer review.



- A team wants to use AI but hasn’t agreed what needs to be tested or approved. Take a worked example from an actuarial or risk team and develop the risk assessment, testing, human review, sign-off and monitoring templates around it.



- A firm has a risk framework already, but its AI governance sits apart from it. Show how to fit AI into existing roles, controls and reporting rather than designing a parallel process. Where useful, automate routine steps while keeping a clear record of what was checked and approved.



You for example might develop a Solvency II readiness checklist that helps a firm see which gaps matter and where it needs support, or scope a liquidity risk review with a clear evidence request and deliverables. You don’t need to be an AI engineer. What matters is being able to connect a technical issue to a problem a client would pay to solve.



Occasional client project work:



When client work comes up, you’ll take on defined pieces of technical analysis for my review. The work will vary by engagement. Examples include:



- Capital modelling and stress testing: Build or adapt capital projections, run scenarios and explain what drives changes in solvency. Assess which management actions could make a meaningful difference.



- Reserving and technical provisions: Calculate or review reserves and technical provisions, reconcile movements between reporting periods and challenge the assumptions that materially affect the result.



- Model review and validation: Reproduce key calculations independently, test inputs, assumptions and edge cases, and investigate unexpected results. Explain which findings matter, why they matter and what you’d check next.



- Asset-liability and liquidity management: Project asset and liability cash flows, identify mismatches or funding gaps, and test the effect of market shocks, lapses or collateral calls. Translate the results into practical limits, monitoring and management reporting.



- Regulatory reporting and other advisory work: Reconcile model outputs to regulatory returns and explain material movements. You might also support a Solvency II readiness review or assess how a proposed reinsurance structure affects risk and capital.



You don’t need experience in every area. You should have hands-on depth in at least one and be comfortable getting up to speed in others.



What I’m looking for

- Around 5–8+ years of relevant actuarial or quantitative risk experience. More experience is welcome. AASP, ASA or equivalent is preferred. I’ll also consider strong progress towards a recognised qualification where you can show comparable technical ownership and judgement. Irish or EU regulatory experience is useful, not essential.



- Strong quantitative skills and a consulting mindset. You can take an initial brief, find the right sources, work independently once the direction is agreed and judge how much analysis the decision needs. You know when to challenge an assumption or flag a gap before drawing a conclusion.



- Commercial judgement. You can explain what a client actually needs, what we should leave out and how to make the work repeatable. You’re comfortable switching between topics as priorities change.



This role suits someone who enjoys varied, self-directed work. It won’t suit someone looking mainly for recurring tasks, detailed instructions or close day-to-day management.



Hours: Initially around 20 hours per month, with scope to increase as the advisory work develops and client projects come up. The hourly rate stays unchanged.



How to apply



Start with a short introduction covering your actuarial background, the level you’ve worked at and where you can add most value. Include your qualification or exam progress, expected hourly rate and availability.



List up to five relevant actuarial or risk projects, with one line each on what the project was and what you personally did. Say whether you led a workstream, built or reviewed the analysis, or supported someone else.



Then answer these four questions. About 150 words each for questions 1 and 2, and a few lines each for 3 and 4, is enough.



1. Taking ownership: Pick one project you took forward from an initial brief. What decision did the client or business need to make? What did you personally own, and what did others own or sign off? What did you prioritise, challenge or leave out, and why? Name a specific output you produced and explain what decision or action it informed.



2. AI in actuarial risk: Where do you see AI making a worthwhile difference over the next two to three years? Pick one use case. What would AI do, what would stay with the actuary or risk team, and how would it fit into the firm’s existing risk framework? How would you test it and d
 whether it was worth doing? You don’t need to have implemented it yourself.



3. Professional involvement: Are you a member of an actuarial, risk or related professional body? If you’ve served on a committee or working group, or volunteered in another capacity, tell me your role and what you contributed. Membership or volunteering isn’t a requirement.



4. Leadership: Give one example of where you showed leadership and made a difference. What needed to change, what did you do, and what was different as a result? This could be taking the lead on a technical issue, helping colleagues improve how they work or moving a project forward without a formal leadership title.

Please anonymise client examples. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a short paid exercise using synthetic data.

description:
Part-Time Fashion Video Editor & Ecommerce Retoucher (Reels + Photoshop) | 3 days/week



PAY

US$180 per week (US$7.50/hour) for 24 hours a week. Long-term contract.



HOURS

Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, 9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time.

That is 6:00am to 2:00pm Philippine time now (Australian daylight saving), and 7:00am to 3:00pm PHT from April. No night shift.



ABOUT THE ROLE

A fast-growing Australian womenswear fashion label wants a creative all-rounder for its in-house creative team. You will split your week between two kinds of work:



1. Social video (about 60%): cutting reels from campaign shoots, influencer content, founder face-to-camera, events and UGC, plus hook and length variations for paid social.

2. Ecommerce stills (about 40%): retouching product and on-model images in Photoshop for the website and a wholesale platform. This covers cleanup, cropping to spec, colour-matching garments, file naming and QC.



This is a hands-on production seat for someone who works fast, follows brand standards closely and takes ownership. The brand is still building its processes, so you need to work well from short briefs and ask good questions early.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Video

- Cut campaign and lookbook footage into reels that put the hero products first (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)

- Edit influencer content, splitting multi-look reels into single posts for organic and paid use

- Edit founder and team face-to-camera content into publish-ready posts

- Cut 3 to 5 hook or length variations of one edit for paid-social A/B testing

- Do same-day edits from events, launches and shoots, plus quick stories from raw footage

- Create simple stop-motion and on-brand motion text using existing templates

- Build reusable templates and presets so you get faster every week



Ecommerce stills

- Retouch product and on-model images in Photoshop: dust, lint, creases, hems, stray threads and background cleanup

- Recolour garments accurately to match a swatch so the colour online matches the real product

- Crop to the specs for website packshots, lifestyle shots and the wholesale platform

- Rename files to the naming convention (style, colour, angle) and file them correctly

- QC every image before delivery and flag soft focus, wrong crops or missing angles

- Keep the image-tracking spreadsheet up to date



HOW WE USE AI

Core retouching is done by hand in Photoshop (healing, clone, frequency separation, masking). AI generation tools are only used when the team asks for them. Please tell us honestly how you use AI today.



MUST-HAVES

- 2+ years editing short-form social video in Premiere Pro and/or CapCut, ideally for fashion, beauty, lifestyle or DTC brands

- 2+ years of Photoshop retouching on product or apparel images, with real before-and-after examples

- After Effects basics: motion text within a template

- Sound and music sense for Reels and TikTok

- Accurate file naming and a strong QC habit

- Comfortable with high volume and quick revisions

- Fluent written and spoken English

- Your own reliable computer that can edit video, stable internet and backup power

- Available Tue, Wed and Thu, 6:00am to 2:00pm PHT



NICE TO HAVE

- Figma, Canva and Lightroom

- Experience with wholesale platforms such as JOOR

- Some on-set or in-store filming experience



HOW TO APPLY

Use the subject line REELS-RETOUCH - [Your Name]. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

Please include:

1. Your CV

2. A link to your portfolio, if you have one (ideally at least 2 short-form reels you edited, fashion or lifestyle preferred). Tell us which software you used and what you did on each.

3. 3 to 5 before-and-after product or apparel retouches. Tell us what you fixed and how. We want to see Photoshop technique, not AI generation.

4. Answers to these questions:

   a) You get 40 seconds of raw influencer footage showing 3 outfits. How would you turn it into organic posts and paid-ad variations? How many cuts would you make, and what would the hooks be?

   b) How do you check that a recoloured garment matches the real product before delivery?

   c) When do you use AI tools in your editing or retouching, and when do you not?

5. Confirm you can work Tue, Wed and Thu, 6:00am to 2:00pm PHT, at US$180 per week, and give your earliest start date.



Shortlisted applicants will do a short practical task: retouch and rename 3 product images and cut one 15-second reel from footage we supply.

- Request Google reviews. Ask customers from recent and older completed jobs for honest reviews and track who has been contacted.

- Manage promotional campaigns set by management. Coordinate campaign materials, launch approved offers, track enquiries and sales, and report results.

- Deliver against agreed KPIs. Report weekly on lead response times, qualified enquiries, quotes, follow-up completion, quote-to-sale conversion and sales by product. Use the results to d
 what to improve next.

Essential skills

- You must be able to use Replit independently. You can navigate an existing project, use its preview, test website changes and document issues for a developer.

- Extensive hands-on SEO and AI search optimisation experience, with evidence of improved visibility, qualified enquiries or sales.

- Confidence with WordPress, Google Search Console, GA4, spreadsheets and CRM systems.

- Experience with quoting, customer follow-up, lead generation and sales or business development.

- Impeccable written and spoken English. You can write clear customer
s and speak confidently and professionally on video calls with customers, partners and our team.

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage work through to completion.

How to apply

1. Introduce yourself briefly and tell us what hours you can work in Perth time.

2. Show evidence of your Replit experience. Share a project link, screenshots or a short screen recording. Explain what you personally built, changed or tested.

3. Show evidence of your SEO and AI search optimisation work. Share a case study, report or before-and-after results. Explain what you did, how you measured it and what changed in visibility, traffic or qualified enquiries.

Title your response: Website Migration VA

title: Short Form Video Editor - Sports Cards and TCG
description:

Key Responsibilities



You will be responsible for editing approximately 5 short-form videos per week, with the opportunity for increased work as our content production grows.



We will provide pre-selected and trimmed video clips, so you will not need to spend hours reviewing raw footage or searching for highlights.



Your responsibilities will include:



Editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
 Reels and YouTube Shorts.



Adding engaging sound effects to emphasise exciting moments.



Speeding up or slowing down certain sections of footage to improve pacing and viewer engagement.



Adding and updating on-screen profit and loss trackers for card opening and challenge videos.



Adding simple text overlays, graphics and visual effects where appropriate.



Including captions or subtitles when required.



Creating smooth transitions and maintaining a professional, engaging editing style.



Ensuring videos are correctly formatted for vertical social media platforms (9:16).



Delivering completed videos within 48 hours of receiving the footage and editing instructions.



Making reasonable revisions when required to ensure videos meet our standards.



The editing requirements will generally be straightforward. We are not looking for complex cinematic editing, but rather someone who understands how to make short-form content entertaining, polished and engaging.



What We're Looking For



Essential Requirements:



- Previous experience editing short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok or YouTube Shorts.

- Proficiency with editing software such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar.

- Good understanding of video pacing, engaging sound effects and social media editing trends.

- Ability to add text overlays, simple graphics and on-screen trackers.

-Strong attention to detail and consistent editing quality.

- Good written English and communication skills.

- Ability to follow instructions and incorporate feedback.

- Reliable internet connection and the ability to meet agreed deadlines.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple videos each week.



Preferred but Not Essential:



- Experience editing sports, trading-card, Pokémon or collectible-related content.

- Familiarity with NBA, football (soccer) or Pokémon.

- Experience creating engaging videos designed to improve audience retention.

- Understanding of current short-form content trends, hooks and sound effects.



You do not need extensive sports-card knowledge to apply. We are primarily looking for someone with strong editing skills, creativity and a willingness to learn our content style.



Compensation & Opportunities



This position will be paid on a fixed per-video basis, with rates negotiated depending on your experience, editing ability and quality of previous work.



We offer:



- Competitive per-video compensation based on experience.

- Consistent ongoing work, initially approximately 5 videos per week.

-Opportunities for increased video volume as the business grows.

-Regular reviews of compensation and performance.

-Clear instructions and pre-selected footage to simplify your workflow.

-Flexibility to work remotely and manage your own editing schedule.

-The opportunity to establish a long-term working relationship with an Australian business.



We value editors who consistently deliver high-quality work, meet deadlines and take initiative in improving our content.



Working Arrangements



This is a fully remote position.



You will generally receive pre-trimmed footage along with instructions outlining the required edits.



Video lengths will vary depending on the content.



We expect completed videos to be delivered within 48 hours, unless otherwise agreed.



Your responsibility will be editing and delivering the final videos. Our team will handle uploading, publishing and managing our social media accounts.



How to Apply



- To be considered for this position, please include the following in your application:

- A brief introduction about yourself and your video editing experience.

- Links to at least 3 examples of short-form videos you have personally edited. These may be Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts or similar.

-Your expected rate per completed video in AUD.

We are particularly interested in seeing examples that demonstrate engaging pacing, creative sound effects, captions, text overlays and visual effects.

Successful candidates will be offered ongoing editing work, with the opportunity to grow alongside the business.



We are looking for someone who is reliable, creative and interested in becoming a valued long-term member of our team.



We look forward to reviewing your application and previous work!



Pinnacle Card Shop

Australia

title: Social Media Marketer for a Health and Wellness Clinic (Claude AI + GoHighLevel)
description:
Full time, 40 hours a week | Monday to Friday, 3 pm to 11 pm US Eastern | Starts Tuesday, December 1, 2026 | USD $1,500 a month in a paid 60-day trial, then USD $1,800



Mac and daily Claude required | Social media marketing for women in midlife | GoHighLevel from ready-made templates



In Philippine time, the shift is 4 am to 12 noon from November to mid-March, and 3 am to 11 am from mid-March to early November (US daylight saving).



Do you love turning a scroll into a conversation, and a conversation into a booked consultation? Do you already use Claude every day, and get a little thrill when a template saves you three hours? Then keep reading.



WHO WE ARE



We're a physician-led medical aesthetics and longevity clinic just north of Toronto, Canada, with more than 25 years in practice. The same owner also runs a separate wellness education company with a published book, a podcast and online programs. Our mission is simple: help people look and feel their best at every age, from the inside out.



You'll work for both companies. They're kept strictly separate, with their own accounts, their own branding and no cross-promotion. The clinic is the busier of the two, and most of your week will go to it. As the wellness company grows, you'll help it grow too.



HOW OUR MARKETING WORKS



You're our in-house social media marketer: the person who makes our channels feel warm and human, turns followers into conversations and conversations into consultations, and creates content for our wellness brand. Our digital marketing agency produces the clinic's landing pages, its SEO and some of its social content, and you keep their work moving too.



Here's the good news: you won't start from a blank page. Think of it like a well-stocked kitchen, where the recipes and the pantry are already in place:

• Custom Claude skills that edit video, build presentation-style web pages (PresoPages), write in our voice and check our rules

• Ready-made GoHighLevel templates (snapshots) from our business coaching program, for funnels, workflows and campaigns

• A written chat playbook, brand guide and compliance rules



What we need is the cook: someone who knows our guests, uses the tools well, and makes it all feel like us.



THE ROLE



This is a full-time role, dedicated only to our two companies. In your first month, our marketing integrator trains you on our systems, skills and templates. After that, you work directly with the owner and our team, alongside our agency, and the owner approves all content.



WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH IT



• Top-of-market pay in USD, plus 13th-month pay and paid Philippine regular holidays

• One long-term team instead of a pile of small clients

• Custom Claude skills and ready-made templates that make your work faster and better

• A front-row seat to how AI is changing marketing

• A seat on a live business coaching program, so you keep learning every week



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. Run our social media and conversations

• Reply to DMs and comments every day using our chat playbook: answer general questions, start real conversations, and invite people to book a consultation

• Hand every health or treatment question to our clinical team the same day. You never give medical advice

• Keep the owner's own account, where most of our followers are, active and engaged alongside the business accounts

• Post and schedule content, and engage with our community and with local accounts to grow our reach

• Watch the comment-keyword funnels and automatic replies, and fix or report anything that misfires

• Read the numbers in Meta insights each week, and tell us what's working and what isn't



2. Create content with our Claude skills

• Edit the short videos the owner films, using our Claude video editing skill

• Turn podcast episodes into clips, carousels and newsletters

• Design carousels in Canva and write captions in our voice

• Build presentation-style web pages (PresoPages) and simple interactive pages with our Claude skills (you describe it, Claude builds it, you check it and polish it), then install them in GoHighLevel

• Support book promotions and online program launches



3. Run GoHighLevel from ready-made templates

• Install and adapt our coaching program's templates (snapshots): funnels, forms, calendars, pipelines, workflows, and
 and SMS campaigns

• Set up comment-keyword triggers and DM automations, and test them before they go live

• Troubleshoot when something doesn't fire, and know when to ask our integrator



4. Keep everything on brand and compliant, alongside our agency

• Check the agency's content against our written rules before it goes to the owner for approval, and flag anything that needs fixing

• Track approvals and deadlines in ClickUp, so nothing goes live without approval and nothing slips

• Send the agency clear briefs and same-day feedback, and supply what they need: video clips, photos (only with documented consent), service details and approved wording

• Post the blogs the owner writes and our Google Business Profile updates



5. Turn our coaching into action

• Attend our business coaching program's live calls (Monday to Thursday at 4 pm Eastern, three weeks a month, plus a 3-day virtual event each quarter, when your hours shift to match)

• Turn what's taught into action items, and get them done



6. Campaigns, events and reporting

• Seasonal campaigns and promotions, and event materials (booth graphics, print orders, follow-up
s)

• A short end-of-day report every working day, and a monthly marketing report

• A step-by-step guide for every task you own



When we start paid advertising, you'll also help with fast follow-up on new leads and with reporting.



MUST-HAVES (WE CHECK EVERY ONE)



• A Mac you own and can install software on, because our Claude video and page-building skills run on a Mac. Plus fast, stable internet, backup internet and backup power

• Daily Claude user. ChatGPT alone isn't enough: you're comfortable with Claude projects and skills (ideally the Claude desktop app), and you check what Claude gives you before it goes anywhere

• 3+ years of business social media or content marketing, with results you can show in real numbers (reach, saves, replies, bookings)

• You know how to speak to our market: warm, clear writing that connects with women in midlife, and the instinct to turn a comment or DM into a booked consultation

• Excellent written English: you'll write to our community every day, in our voice

• Working GoHighLevel skills, about a year or more: you can install and adapt a template (snapshot), edit a workflow and troubleshoot when something doesn't fire. You don't need to build complex systems from scratch; we give you the templates and the skills

• Available 3 pm to 11 pm US Eastern, Monday to Friday, including the live calls, and able to start on Tuesday, December 1, 2026

• This is your main job: no other client work during our hours

• Detail-first: you follow written rules exactly, and you ask when something is unclear

• Comfortable in Canva and with short-form video editing (our Claude skill does the heavy lifting)



WHAT MAKES YOU STAND OUT



• Marketing for a clinic, med spa, health practice, wellness brand, coach or author, especially in women's health, menopause or healthy aging

• Appointment setting, or selling by chat

• Pages, tools or automations you've built with Claude ("vibe coding")

• Experience in a regulated industry, where every claim gets checked and privacy matters

• Experience with GoHighLevel snapshots, HighLevel Certified Admin, or Meta certifications

• Repurposing podcasts or YouTube videos, course or book launches, or Substack

• Reading the numbers in Meta insights, Google Business Profile or Google Analytics

• Experience with AI voice or video tools, and with labelling AI content correctly

• Client relationships of two years or more, and strong client reviews

• Envato, Palmier Pro, ClickUp or Hubstaff



HOW WE'LL TRAIN YOU



• Weeks 1 and 2: live training with our marketing integrator, about 20 hours a week, on our accounts, Claude skills, GoHighLevel templates, playbooks and rules

• Weeks 3 and 4: you take over step by step, with a daily check-in

• Our agency walks you through its approval process and its dashboard

• You'll have our brand guide, our written compliance rules, our chat playbook, our Claude skills, and step-by-step guides you'll help keep current



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



• Every day: DMs and comments answered during your shift, health questions handed to our clinical team the same day, and an end-of-day report

• Every week: content posted on schedule, and a look at the numbers to see what's working

• Within one business day: every content batch from our agency checked against our rules

• Always: nothing goes live without the owner's approval

• By day 30: you know our systems, skills and rules, and you run the daily DM and comment sweep

• By day 60: you run the daily work on your own, make content with our Claude skills every week, and every recurring task has a step-by-step guide

• Every month: a short report on conversations started, consultations booked from DMs, response times and the content that worked best



PAY AND BENEFITS



• USD $1,500 a month during a paid 60-day trial

• USD $1,800 a month once you pass the trial

• 13th-month pay (prorated in your first year)

• Paid Philippine regular holidays

• Long-term independent contractor role, paid in USD



HOW WE TRACK WORK (PLEASE READ)



We believe in clear expectations from day one, so here is exactly how we track work:



• We use Hubstaff, a time tracker that runs on your computer whenever you're working for us.

• It records your hours, the apps and websites you use, and an activity level (whether your keyboard and mouse are in use, never what you type).

• It takes screenshots of your screen while the timer runs.

• You track your time to the right company, since we run two separate companies.

• We review this data every day, with help from an AI assistant, alongside the work you deliver. Your output matters most; tracking keeps things fair and clear for both sides.

• We expect 40 tracked hours a week. Untracked time can't count toward those hours.

• You can see your own data at any time.



If being tracked isn't for you, no hard feelings, but this role isn't the right fit.



CONFIDENTIALITY



We're a medical practice. You'll sign a confidentiality agreement before you start, covering any personal health information that comes through messages, and you'll work in your own logins (never shared passwords). You won't need access to patient medical records, and each company's information stays with that company.



HOW WE'LL CHOOSE



We're hiring quickly, and we review every application that follows the instructions.



1. Applications close Thursday, November 26, at 9 am US Eastern (10 pm Manila time).

2. Shortlisted applicants get a paid test task (about 3 hours) that day, due Friday at 9 pm US Eastern (10 am Saturday, Manila time).

3. Interviews are on Saturday, November 28: a 30-minute video call that includes a short live screen-share in Claude and GoHighLevel.

4. We check two client references.

5. The role starts on Tuesday, December 1, with a paid 60-day trial.



HOW TO APPLY



 your application to 
 review applications by
 only, so if you also apply through this site, please send the
 too.



Already
ed us an application? It still stands, so there's no need to send it again.



Use this subject line: Your full name | Social Media Marketer



In one
, send us:



1. Quick answers

   a. Can you work 3 pm to 11 pm US Eastern, Monday to Friday, attend the live calls, and start on Tuesday, December 1? Yes or no.

   b. What time does this shift start where you live?

   c. Will this be your only job during these hours? Yes or no.

   d. How many years have you worked in social media or content marketing, with Claude, and in GoHighLevel?

   e. Rate yourself from 1 to 5 on social media marketing, caption writing, Claude, GoHighLevel, Canva, short-form video editing and Meta Business Suite.



2. Proof of your work (links, not large attachments)

   a. Your resume, as a PDF

   b. A link to your profile with client reviews or ratings (OnlineJobs, Upwork or LinkedIn), plus your OnlineJobs ID Proof score if you have one

   c. A business social account you've managed, and one post or Reel you're proud of, with its results

   d. One Canva design and one short video you edited

   e. Something you made with Claude: a page, a tool, a piece of content or a skill you set up (a link or screenshots)

   f. Optional: a GoHighLevel workflow, funnel or template you set up (screenshots are fine)

   g. Screenshots of your Mac's "About This Mac" window and of an internet speed test



3. A 2 to 3 minute Loom video: introduce yourself, then show us one piece of marketing you made (ideally with Claude's help) and tell us what results it got.



4. Short answers, in your own words (100 words or fewer each)

   a. A Reel gets 25 comments asking for our free guide. What do you do in the next hour?

   b. Write a 3-line caption for a 50-year-old woman who keeps waking up at 3 am.

   c. Our agency sends 30 scripts for approval. One promises "guaranteed results" and another quotes a happy client by name. What do you do?

   d. Someone sends us a DM asking whether a treatment is right for them. What exactly would you reply?

   e. Tell us one specific thing you've built or fixed using Claude.



We use AI every day and love it, but here we want to hear from you. Answers that read as copied and pasted won't move forward.



We're looking forward to meeting you.



One last thing, and it matters. This role lives in the details, so here's your first one: start your subject line with the words "Testing, not guessing", and make those same words the very first line of your
. Applications without them won't be reviewed.

title: Appointment Setter | $5 an Hour + $150 Commission | Neutral Accent Only (Voice Sample Required)
description:
Apollo Media

Appointment Setter



Overview

Apollo Media is a marketing company catered toward the kitchen and bathroom remodeling industry. We help business owners by building professional websites, automating customer relationship management, running
 ads, and helping them rank higher on Google. We are looking to hire two experienced cold callers to prospect local American businesses and set appointments for our sales team.



What We're Looking For

2+ years of cold calling, telemarketing, or appointment setting experience.

Excellent spoken and written American English: clear, neutral, and easy for U.S. business owners to understand.

Confident, professional phone presence and ability to follow a script without sounding robotic or overly "salesy."

Organized and proactive employees who are comfortable managing daily outreach activity with minimal supervision.



What You'll Do

Make outbound cold calls to U.S. kitchen and bathroom remodeling business owners using provided leads and scripts.

Introduce Apollo Media's services and explain how we help remodelers capture more inquiries and book more jobs.

Qualify prospects, handle basic objections, and book qualified discovery calls for our sales team.

Follow up with warm leads and past inquiries.

Maintain accurate records of every call, conversation, and appointment in our CRM (GoHighLevel).

Collaborate with the sales team to refine outreach and improve booking rates.



Performance Expectations

Specific targets will be set after training. Performance is measured on:

Completed outbound calls per day

Booked appointment show rate (those who actually attend)

Organized follow-up completion



Is This Job Right for You?

We'll let you know now, this job is hard. Most of your calls will end in a no, a hang-up, a gatekeeper, or voi
, and you have to keep dialing for the full 4 hours anyway with no one standing over you. Every call is logged and reviewed, and your performance is tracked daily. If you need someone pushing you to stay on task, do not apply. This is for hard workers who are willing and ready to learn and study their sales craft on their own to get better. If you put in the work and work well with us, we will do well by you.



Equipment & Workspace

Reliable power setup with a UPS (uninterruptible power supply) to bridge short outages without dropping calls; backup power for longer interruptions is strongly preferred.

Reliable wired internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps; 50+ Mbps preferred).

Quiet, dedicated workspace for calls.

Quality headset with microphone.

Desktop or laptop computer (Windows 10/11 or macOS).

Backup internet (mobile hotspot or secondary connection) in case of outages.

title: Senior Google Ads & Lead Generation Specialist – Google Ads, CRM, Landing Pages (Part-Time → Long-Term)
description:

Pay: USD $10/hour or AUD $15/hour (depending on the company)



Hours: Initially part-time, with opportunities to grow



Location: Remote – Philippines



Company: Growing Digital Marketing Agency | Multiple International Businesses



About Us



We are a growing digital marketing agency working with local service businesses, particularly dental clinics, local service businesses and providers, and other appointment-based businesses.



We operate multiple companies and are looking for an experienced, results-driven Google Ads and Lead Generation Specialist who can manage the complete customer acquisition process.



We are a startup agency with long-term growth plans. We want someone who can initially work part-time, demonstrate their abilities, and grow alongside us.



We are not looking for someone who simply sets up advertising campaigns. We want someone who understands how to generate leads, track them through a CRM (GHL preferably but open), measure actual business results, and continuously improve performance.



Your Responsibilities



1. Google Ads Strategy & Campaign Management



* Research keywords, competitors, and local markets.

* Build and manage Google Search campaigns from scratch.

* Structure campaigns to generate qualified leads at competitive costs.

* Manage keywords, negative keywords, bidding strategies, budgets, and ad copy.

* Continuously test and optimise campaigns.

* Focus on actual enquiries, appointments, and customers rather than just clicks.

* Experience with dental clinics and local service businesses is particularly valuable.



2. Landing Pages & Conversion Optimisation



* Independently build high-converting landing pages.

* Preferably use GoHighLevel (GHL), although we are open to other platforms.

* Create compelling offers, headlines, forms, and calls to action.

* Run A/B tests to improve conversion rates.

* Ensure landing pages are mobile-friendly, fast, and properly tracked.

* Connect landing pages directly to the CRM and lead management system.



3. CRM Setup, Lead Tracking & Client Dashboards – Essential



You must be capable of independently setting up and managing a CRM system, preferably using GoHighLevel, although we are open to better solutions.



Our goal is to provide clients with transparent, measurable proof of the results our marketing generates.



Responsibilities include:



* Build and configure CRM systems for individual clients.

* Create sales pipelines to track leads from initial enquiry through to booked appointments and completed sales.

* Connect Google Ads, landing pages, forms, phone calls, and other lead sources to the CRM.

* Set up automated lead capture, notifications, and follow-up workflows.

* Implement lead source attribution and conversion tracking.

* Create professional, easy-to-understand client dashboards.

* Track cost per lead, qualified leads, booked appointments, conversion rates, and cost per acquisition.

* Where client data allows, report on revenue generated and return on advertising spend.

* Ensure clients can clearly see where their leads come from and what results our campaigns are delivering.



We want to demonstrate real business outcomes, not just advertising metrics.



4. Tracking, Analytics & Reporting



* Set up Google Tag Manager, GA4, and Google Ads conversion tracking.

* Track calls, forms, appointment bookings, and other meaningful conversions.

* Implement offline conversion tracking where possible.

* Troubleshoot tracking and attribution issues.

* Build reliable reporting systems that combine advertising performance with CRM data.

* Provide clear recommendations based on campaign results.



5. Continuous Testing & Optimisation



* Proactively identify opportunities to improve campaign performance.

* Test new keywords, advertising messages, landing pages, and offers.

* Analyse lead quality and identify wasted advertising spend.

* Develop strategies to improve appointment bookings and customer acquisition.

* Regularly suggest improvements without waiting for instructions.



6. Social Media Lead Generation – Bonus Skill



Experience with Meta Ads, particularly
 and Instagram lead generation or youtube is highly desirable.



Ideally, you can:



* Create and manage
 and Instagram lead generation campaigns.

* Set up Meta instant lead forms and landing page campaigns.

* Connect Meta leads to the CRM.

* Track lead quality, appointment bookings, and conversions.

* Build retargeting campaigns.

* Understand how Google Ads and Meta Ads can work together to generate more customers.



Social media advertising experience is a bonus, but strong Google Ads and CRM expertise is our main priority.



Required Skills & Experience



* Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on Google Ads experience.

* Proven success with local business lead generation.

* Experience with dental clinics, healthcare providers, or appointment-based businesses is strongly preferred.

* Ability to independently manage campaigns from setup to ongoing optimisation.

* Ability to build landing pages and implement conversion tracking.

* Practical experience setting up CRMs, lead pipelines, and client reporting dashboards.

* Strong understanding of lead attribution and conversion tracking.

* Ability to work independently, solve problems, and take ownership of results.

* Good written English and communication skills.



Preferred Additional Skills



* GoHighLevel CRM, funnels, workflows, and reporting.

* Meta Ads and Instagram lead generation.

* Call tracking and offline conversion imports.

* Google Looker Studio dashboards.

* Appointment booking automations.

* Experience with Australian or US local businesses.

* Dental marketing funnels and patient acquisition strategies.



What We Offer



* USD $10/hour or AUD $15/hour, depending on the company.

* Flexible part-time hours initially.

* Opportunity to increase hours as our client base expands.

* Long-term opportunities across multiple businesses.

* Freedom to recommend better tools and strategies.

* Potential to become our lead performance marketing specialist.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions. Generic applications without relevant examples will not be prioritised.



1. How many years have you personally managed Google Ads campaigns?

2. Have you generated leads for dental clinics or other local businesses? Please provide specific examples.

3. What was your most successful lead generation campaign? Include monthly advertising budget, cost per lead, and results.

4. Have you independently built and configured a CRM? Which platform did you use?

5. Can you set up a complete GoHighLevel system, including landing pages, pipelines, automations, tracking, and client dashboards?

6. How would you prove to a dental clinic that your advertising generated actual booked appointments rather than just leads?

7. Do you have experience with
 or Instagram lead generation campaigns?

8. Which reporting and dashboard tools have you used?

9. Please provide screenshots, examples, or case studies demonstrating your results, with confidential information removed.



Our Hiring Process



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview and a paid practical skills test.



We will initially work together part-time to evaluate your technical abilities, communication, initiative, and results.



Successful candidates will have the opportunity to grow with our agency as we acquire more clients.



We are looking for someone who can own the entire lead generation system — from the first advertising click to a tracked, qualified lead, booked appointment, and measurable client result.



If you are an experienced, proactive specialist who enjoys testing, optimising, and building systems that deliver measurable business results, we would love to hear from you.

title: Sales Closer, Tech Sales, for a U.S. AI & Lead Systems Agency ($4 to $10/hr + Bonus + Commission)
description:
Type of work: Part-time

Hours: 4 to 6 hours a day, Monday to Friday, during U.S. business hours. We'll set your start time together.

Pay: $4 to $10 an hour, plus bonus and commission



We're a U.S. agency that builds AI and lead systems for businesses. Our appointment setters book calls with U.S. business owners. We need a closer to run those calls and close the deal.



Please read this whole post before you apply. We are only looking at two things: perfect English and real sales experience.



IF THIS ISN'T YOU, PLEASE DON'T APPLY



- If your English isn't perfect, please don't apply. You'll be talking to U.S. business owners on video and phone calls all day. Good English isn't enough for this job.

- If you have never closed a sale yourself, please don't apply. Booking meetings or customer service alone doesn't count.

- If you have no tech sales experience, please don't apply.

- Don't send a resume. We won't open it. Your recording and your answers below are your application.



WHAT YOU'LL SELL



Most businesses already get calls and web forms. The problem is what happens next. Calls go to voi
 after hours, forms sit for hours with no answer, and follow-ups slip. We build the systems that fix that:



- AI receptionist. Answers calls, texts and web chats day and night, asks the right questions and books the job.

- Custom CRM. Every lead in one place, with follow-up going out on a schedule.

- Lead engine. Finds and researches new prospects for their team to call.

- Reputation engine. Asks every customer for a review and drafts a reply to each new one.

- Reporting dashboard. Leads, calls, booked jobs and revenue on one screen, by location and by source.

- Custom AI tools built around how they work.

- Website and search. The website and the Google, Google Maps and AI answer work that bring the leads in.



Everything we do is remote.



WHO YOU'LL TALK TO



Owners and managers of U.S. businesses with a real team, like law firms, home service companies (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, solar), medical and dental clinics, and commercial and B2B companies.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Run sales calls with business owners our setters booked for you.

- Find out how their leads come in today and where they go missing.

- Show them how our systems fix it, handle their objections, and close the deal.

- Follow up with everyone who didn't say yes on the first call.

- Log every call and note in our CRM.



We'll train you on our offers, our pricing and our process before your first call.



TWO RULES



- Never promise results, like more leads, more revenue or #1 on Google. Sell what the system does.

- Only quote prices we give you.



PAY



- You start at $4 an hour with a short paid trial.

- Your hourly rate goes up to $10 an hour as you close deals.

- Bonus and commission on every sale you close.

- We'll go over the exact amounts on our call.



WHAT YOU NEED



- Perfect spoken and written English.

- A college degree in English, like a BA in English, English Literature or English Language Studies, or an Education degree with a major in English.

- Real sales experience where you closed deals yourself, including tech sales. Software, SaaS, AI, IT services or digital marketing all count. Selling to businesses (B2B) is a big plus.

- Energy and enthusiasm. Owners buy from people who sound like they believe in what they sell.

- A computer with Chrome, a webcam, a noise-canceling headset and a quiet room.

- Fast, stable internet with a backup, like a hotspot or a second line.



HOW TO APPLY



Send all of this. Applications missing any part won't be read.



1. Put the words AI RECEPTIONIST at the start of your subject line, so we know you read the whole post.

2. Your name, your hourly rate, and how many hours a day you can work (4 to 6).

3. Your English degree: the degree, the school and the year you finished.

4. Your sales experience. What tech product or service did you sell, who did you sell it to, about how many deals did you close a month, and what was the biggest deal you closed?

5. A 60 to 90 second voice recording or video made for this job. Introduce yourself and tell us about a deal you closed. Send a 
 link for a voice recording, or a Loom or unlisted YouTube link for a video.

6. A speed test link from speedtest.net.



No resume, please.



We're hiring one person, so agencies and teams, please don't apply.



Thanks!

title: Chief of Staff- Senior Home Care
description:
About us

Seniors Helping Seniors® Mid-South Georgia is a non-medical in-home care agency serving families in Augusta, Lake Country and Macon, Georgia. Our caregivers provide companionship and personal care so seniors can stay at home. It feels "like getting a little help from your friends"™.

• Mission: To help more seniors thrive at home by providing compassionate care that feels like support from a trusted friend.

• Vision: Love in Abundance.

• Core value: Reciprocal Dignity. We honor the dignity of our caregivers as much as that of our clients.

• Our promise: The Show Up Standard™. If a caregiver calls out, we replace them with an available caregiver with a similar skill set.

We are a growing agency with a lean US-based leadership team and a remote team of virtual professionals, most of them based in the Philippines.

Role summary

The Chief of Staff runs the team's day-to-day workflow so our President/CEO can focus on growth, key relationships and strategy. You will be the CEO's right hand and the team's first point of contact. You will run the team's routine meetings, keep every project moving and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

This is a full-time remote leadership role. It reports directly to the President/CEO.

In short, you will:

• Lead the team's meetings and 1:1s in place of the CEO

• Own the team's task boards, deadlines and follow-up

• Turn the CEO's priorities into clear assignments and track them to done

• Report to the CEO each week on progress, results, risks and the decisions she needs to make

Key responsibilities

1. Team leadership and meetings

• Run the daily, weekly and 1:1 meetings listed below. Set the agenda, keep time, take notes and send action items the same day.

• Hold each team member accountable for deadlines and KPIs. Coach them when work slips, and escalate to the CEO only when needed.

• Onboard new virtual team members to our tools, standards and meeting rhythm.

2. Workflow and project management

• Own the team's task board. Every task has an owner, a due date and a status.

• Break the CEO's goals and quarterly initiatives into projects, milestones and weekly assignments.

• Spot bottlenecks and handoff gaps between teams, for example from recruiting to scheduling, or from a new client lead to onboarding.

• Write and update our standard operating procedures (SOPs) as processes change.

3. Reporting and KPIs

• Keep the weekly meeting dashboard current. It is organized by Attract Clients, Retain Clients, Attract Caregivers, Retain Caregivers and Scheduling.

• Send the CEO a one-page weekly brief covering wins, KPIs against goal, risks, open decisions and next week's priorities.

• Track our Show Up Standard™: the percent of weekly shifts filled and completed.

4. CEO support

• Act as the gatekeeper for the CEO's time. Route questions to the right person, and bring her only what needs her decision.

• Prepare the CEO for her meetings with briefs, data and talking points.

• Follow up on her commitments to partners, vendors and the team.

Who you'll lead and the meetings you'll run

You will manage the daily work of our virtual team and coordinate with our US-based staff.

What success looks like

By day 90, the CEO no longer runs the team's routine meetings, and every open task has an owner and a due date.

First 30 days: Learn our services, team, tools and KPIs. Sit in on every meeting with the CEO. Build or clean up the team's task board.

By day 60: Lead the daily scheduling meeting, the Monday staff meeting and all team 1:1s. Send the CEO's weekly brief on time every week.

By day 90: Run the full meeting rhythm on your own. Have the weekly dashboard filled in by every team lead before Monday. Have at least two new or updated SOPs in place.



How we measure you:

• Action items closed by their due date

• Weekly dashboard and CEO brief delivered on time

• Show Up Standard™ shift fill rate held or improved

• Hours of CEO time spent in routine team meetings, trending down to near zero

Requirements

• 3+ years as a Chief of Staff, Executive Assistant to a CEO, Operations Manager or Project Manager, including leading a team

• Experience managing remote teams and running meetings for US-based companies

• Excellent written and spoken English. You will speak with US staff, caregivers and partners.

• Strong with technology: Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Calendar), Zoom or Google Meet, and a project tool such as Asana, ClickUp, Trello or 

• A record of follow-through. You close loops without being reminded.

• Honest, organized and calm under pressure. You tell the CEO the truth about what is and is not getting done.

• Reliable high-speed internet, a backup power source and a quiet workspace

Nice to have:

• Experience in home care, healthcare or another service business with shift scheduling

• Familiarity with WellSky or another home care scheduling system

• Experience building KPI dashboards and writing SOPs

• Experience working for a franchise

Schedule, pay and how to apply

• Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours a week, Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM US Eastern Time (10 PM–6 AM Philippine Time)

• Pay: $5-$9 per hour, based on experience. Includes a 90-day review.

• Type: Remote, independent contractor



How to apply. Applications that skip a step will not be reviewed.

1.  Use the subject line "Chief of Staff – Show Up".

2.  Send your resume with two examples of teams or projects you managed. Include the team size, the tools you used and a result you can show with a number.

3.  Record a 3-minute video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself and explaining how you run a weekly team meeting.

4.  Answer in writing, in 200 words or less: A team member has missed the same deadline twice. The CEO asks you for an update in one hour. What do you do?

Finalists will complete a short paid work sample and a live interview. We will ask you to show proof of the experience on your resume.

title: Zoho CRM & Desk Developer / Integration Specialist (Project-Based)
description:
Job Type: Project-Based / Potential Long-Term Engagement

Working Hours: U.S. Time Zone (Eastern Time)

Payment: Payoneer

Time Tracking: Timeproof (Mandatory)



Job Overview



We are looking for an experienced Zoho Developer / Implementation Specialist to set up and customize Zoho CRM, Zoho Desk, and related applications and integrate them with our in-house Internal Business System (IBS).



We operate multiple restaurant brands and locations across the United States. Our goal is to build a centralized customer support and communication system with secure integrations, automated workflows, and reporting.



This is initially a project-based position. The right candidate will be considered for ongoing, long-term engagement as we continue developing and expanding our business systems.



Key Responsibilities



1. Zoho Setup & Configuration



- Set up and configure multiple Zoho CRM organizations and Zoho Desk environments.

- Configure brands, locations, users, roles, permissions, and departments.

- Implement customer support ticketing, assignment rules, and escalation workflows.

- Configure Zoho Analytics for management reporting.

- Maintain appropriate data separation between business organizations.



2. Communication & Helpdesk Integration



- Integrate Twilio for phone calls, SMS, and call routing.

- Configure customer support
, IVR, voi
, and call history.

- Automate ticket creation, notifications, follow-ups, and escalations.

- Support future integrations with WhatsApp, live chat, and AI-powered customer support.



3. Integration With Our In-House System



- Integrate Zoho with our existing web-based Internal Business System (IBS).

- Develop and configure REST API, webhook, and middleware integrations.

- Synchronize relevant customer, order, location, and ticket information.

- Enable ticket status updates, notifications, and workflow automation between systems.

- Coordinate directly with our in-house development team.



4. Automation & Reporting



- Configure workflows for customer complaints, refunds, approvals, and escalations.

- Automate ticket routing by organization, brand, location, and issue type.

- Create operational dashboards and performance reports.

- Optimize workflows for efficiency and scalability.



5. Testing & Documentation



- Perform integration testing, troubleshooting, and deployment.

- Ensure proper security, user permissions, and data protection.

- Provide technical documentation and administrator training.

- Support system improvements after implementation.



Required Skills & Experience



- Strong hands-on experience with Zoho CRM and Zoho Desk.

- Experience with Zoho Flow, Deluge scripting, Zoho APIs, and webhooks.

- Experience integrating Zoho with custom-built web applications.

- Knowledge of Twilio Voice and SMS integration.

- Proficiency in REST APIs, JSON, OAuth 2.0, and workflow automation.

- Understanding of role-based permissions and multi-organization configurations.

- Ability to work independently and coordinate with other developers.

- Good written and spoken English communication skills.



Preferred Skills



- PHP and MySQL experience.

- Zoho Analytics and Zoho SalesIQ.

- Experience with customer support and call-routing systems.

- Experience supporting multi-location or multi-brand businesses.



Work Requirements



- Must be available to work during U.S. business hours (Eastern Time).

- Must use Timeproof to track all working hours and activities. Payment for time-based work will be based on verified work records.

- Payments will be made through Payoneer according to agreed project milestones or verified working hours.

- Must provide regular progress updates and communicate with our development team.

- Must be able to deliver working solutions, not just recommendations.



Project Deliverables



1. Fully configured Zoho CRM and Zoho Desk environments.

2. Working Twilio phone/SMS integration and customer support workflows.

3. Secure API integration between Zoho and IBS.

4. Automated ticketing, routing, and escalation workflows.

5. Management dashboards and reporting.

6. Complete testing, documentation, and knowledge transfer.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are continuously developing our internal business platform and expanding our operations. Successful completion of this project may lead to ongoing work involving Zoho enhancements, API integrations, workflow automation, system maintenance, and future development projects.



How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Your experience with Zoho CRM, Zoho Desk, SalesIQ and API integrations.

2. Examples of similar projects you have completed.

3. Your experience integrating Twilio with Zoho.

4. Your estimated timeline and project-based rate or quotation.

5. Your availability to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

6. Confirmation that you agree to use Timeproof and receive payments through Payoneer.



Important: We are looking for a hands-on Zoho specialist who can independently configure, develop, integrate, test, and deliver a working system.

title: Spanish-Speaking Medical Virtual Assistant
description:
• Pay: USD 750 a month base, plus performance incentives with no cap. Our top performers take home USD 1,300 to 1,500 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern (10 PM to 7 AM in Manila), with some weekend shifts for coverage

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote, from a quiet room at home

• Languages: fluent spoken Spanish and English. You call patients in both.



A CALL, FOR EXAMPLE

Your first call of the day is to a woman in her sixties with COPD who speaks only Spanish. Her health system referred her to us last week. She asks how you got her number, and says her daughter usually deals with her doctors. In Spanish, you explain who we are and how our team can help her stay well at home, answer her questions, and book her first visit. Your next call is in English.



THE JOB

Health systems across the US refer older patients with heart failure or COPD to us, often after a hospital stay. Many of them speak Spanish. You call them, explain in plain words how our doctors, nurses and respiratory therapists can care for them at home, and book their first video visit. For a patient who speaks Spanish, you are the first person at AnsibleHealth they can talk to in their own language.



You make 45 to 60 calls a day. Most go to voi
, and about a dozen become real conversations. Some patients are wary, some are tired of doctors, some just want someone to listen. Your job is to help each one d
 whether to join, and to get them to a first visit within a week or so. Between calls you schedule visits, keep patient records up to date and work with our clinical team.



ABOUT ANSIBLEHEALTH

AnsibleHealth is a US medical group for people living with serious heart and lung disease, such as heart failure and COPD. Health systems and health plans send us their patients, often right after a hospital stay. Our own doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses and respiratory therapists then look after them at home by video and phone: we adjust medicines, treat flare-ups early, teach patients and their families, and are on call day and night. The goal is fewer trips back to the hospital. We were founded in 2021, are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital and AlleyCorp, and our team works across the United States and the Philippines.



WHAT YOU NEED



• Fluent spoken Spanish that a Spanish-speaking patient in the US understands the first time, including medicine names, numbers and times

• Clear spoken English that a US patient understands the first time

• 2 or more years on the phone in customer service or healthcare

• Comfort with clinical topics: nursing or other clinical training, or healthcare work where you talked with patients about their conditions

• A quiet room, internet of 30 Mbps or faster, and a backup for outages

• Availability for this shift for the long term

A healthcare degree, US healthcare accounts, sales or appointment-setting experience, or calls handled in Spanish at work are a plus.



This is a phone job with daily targets, not back-office or
 work. If you like talking with people and helping them say yes to care, you will do well here.



HOW TO APPLY (ABOUT 20 MINUTES)



1. Apply only at 
 . Applications sent any other way are not reviewed.

2. Answer a few quick questions in English.

3. Complete the Spanish section of the form. Its instructions are below, in Spanish only.

4. Record your voice on the form, first in English and then in Spanish. Each time you read three lines from a real call, then answer a patient in your own words (about ten minutes in all).

5. Give your earliest start date and the notice you owe your current employer.



EN ESPAÑOL

Esta parte del anuncio está solo en español, a propósito: en este trabajo usted llama a pacientes que hablan español. En la solicitud le pedimos tres cosas en español:



1. Escribir la palabra clave. Cuando el formulario le pida la palabra clave, escriba GIRASOL.

2. Responder por escrito una pregunta breve.

3. Grabar su voz: leer tres frases de una llamada real y responderle a una paciente con sus propias palabras.



If you are shortlisted, we
 you a link to book a 15-minute call with our recruiter.

s and correspondence.

What We’re Looking For

8:00am to 5:00pm Brisbane, Australia time (AEST)



6:00am to 3:00pm Philippines time (PHT)

title: US Tax Preparer / Assistant — Tax Returns & Bookkeeping | EA / PTIN a Plus

Thank you!

— Jen D

title: YouTube Video Editor & Social Media Content Manager
description:
About Us:

Lemuria Citi is a personal brand focused on relationships, intimacy, emotional awareness, self-discovery, and personal growth.



Our content is educational, conversational, thought-provoking, and occasionally playful or provocative. We create meaningful conversations that encourage curiosity, connection, and personal growth.



We're looking for a creative, detail-oriented YouTube Video Editor & Social Media Content Manager to help us produce engaging, high-quality content for YouTube and Instagram.



This is a long-term, part-time opportunity for someone who can combine excellent video editing skills with creativity, organization, and an understanding of social media growth.



Responsibilities:

Video Editing & Content Creation

- Edit approximately 1 long-form YouTube video per week (typically 8–20 minutes).

- Repurpose long-form videos into approximately 2 engaging YouTube Shorts/Instagram Reels per week.

- Create compelling hooks, clean captions, intentional B-roll, tasteful graphics, and on-screen text.

- Maintain professional audio, color, pacing, and overall production quality.

- Design eye-catching, on-brand YouTube thumbnails and Instagram Reel covers.



YouTube & Instagram Management:

- Write compelling, SEO-optimized YouTube titles, descriptions, and chapters.

- Prepare Instagram captions and relevant hashtags.

- Organize content using a shared content calendar.

- Schedule and publish approved content.

- Monitor basic performance metrics and recommend improvements.

- Help identify opportunities to improve audience engagement, retention, and discoverability.



Creative Collaboration:

- Work directly with our Content Manager, who will provide creative direction and final approval.

- Suggest creative ways to make educational talking-head videos more visually engaging.

- Maintain consistent branding across YouTube and Instagram.

- Manage assigned tasks independently and meet agreed deadlines.



Our Editing Style:

This is extremely important to us.



We are NOT looking for overly flashy editing, constant zoom effects, random stock footage, excessive transitions, or generic AI-generated visuals.



We want someone who can create content that feels:

- Polished, elevated, and professional

- Natural, authentic, and conversational

- Visually interesting without being distracting

- Thoughtful, creative, and intentional

- Modern, clean, and appealing to both men and women



Our videos are primarily educational talking-head content. Your creativity should enhance the message, not overpower it.



We value editors who understand storytelling, pacing, and when to let a powerful message speak for itself.



Qualifications:

- Proven experience editing long-form YouTube videos and short-form content.

- Strong skills in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or comparable professional editing software.

- Experience creating high-quality YouTube thumbnails and social media graphics.

- Understanding of YouTube SEO, audience retention, and content optimization.

- Familiarity with YouTube Studio, Instagram, and Meta Business Suite.

- Strong written English and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently, stay organized, and communicate consistently.

- Comfortable working with educational content discussing relationships, intimacy, sexuality, and personal development.



Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, Gling, CapCut, or AI-assisted editing tools is a plus.



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction and your relevant experience.

2. Links to 2–3 long-form YouTube videos you personally edited, preferably educational, talking-head, or storytelling content.

3. Links to 2–3 YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels you've edited.

4. Examples of YouTube thumbnails you've designed.

5. Your experience managing YouTube and/or Instagram accounts.

6. Your preferred editing software and typical workflow.

7. Your expected hourly rate within our advertised range.



**Please also answer these three questions:**



1. How would you make a 15-minute educational talking-head video more engaging without relying on excessive effects or random B-roll?



2. Describe your process for turning one long-form YouTube video into two compelling Shorts or Reels.



3. Have you managed YouTube or Instagram accounts beyond editing? If so, what responsibilities did you handle, and what results can you share?



We are looking for someone who genuinely understands content creation, not simply someone who can cut and assemble footage.



If you're a creative editor who values storytelling, quality, and thoughtful collaboration, we'd love to see your work!

title: Short-Form Video Creator for Meta Andromeda Ads (Reels, Instagram, Facebook) | Music Promotion
description:
ABOUT US

We are a music promotion company that helps independent artists get their music heard. We run curated Spotify playlists and a set of Instagram accounts that connect artists with real listeners. Most new artists find us through our paid ads on Instagram and
, so the quality of our video ads directly affects how fast we grow.

We are looking for a creative, data-minded video creator who can turn a scroll into a click.



THE ROLE

You will create video content for several of our music playlists, each with its own genre and audience:

- Indie Rock

- Hip-Hop

- Neoclassical

- Soul & R&B

- Lo-Fi

- [and more]

Each playlist needs its own visual style and tone. A Lo-Fi ad should not feel like a Hip-Hop ad. You need to be able to switch styles and still keep the content strong.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Create short vertical videos (9:16) for Reels, Stories and Meta feed ads, aimed at people on Instagram and
 to follow our 
 playlists. 

- Produce a high volume of genuinely different ad concepts: new hooks, angles, formats, visual styles and messages, not just small edits of the same video

- Write scroll-stopping hooks for the first 1 to 3 seconds, plus short on-screen text and captions

- Use AI tools (video generation, voiceover, editing, captioning, image generation) to produce content quickly without losing quality

- Review ad performance with us (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, cost per click, landing page views) and use the results to plan the next round of creatives

- Keep creatives within Meta's ad policies and music licensing rules, so ads don't get rejected or muted

- Organize and label all creatives so we can track which concepts win



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- A portfolio of short-form videos or ads you made yourself. Paid social ads with results are a big plus.

- A solid understanding of how Meta Andromeda changed advertising: the creative now does most of the targeting, broad audiences are standard, and the algorithm rewards real creative diversity over many near-identical variations

- Hands-on experience with AI content tools (for example CapCut, Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Veo, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, or similar). Tell us which ones you use.

- Strong editing skills: pacing, captions, transitions, sound design, text animation

- Good written English for hooks and on-screen copy aimed at a Western audience of musicians

- Ability to work independently, meet deadlines and deliver in batches

- Reliable internet and a computer that can handle video editing



NICE TO HAVE

- Knowledge of the music industry, Spotify, playlists or independent artist culture

- Experience with Meta Ads Manager and reading ad performance data

- Motion graphics or basic animation skills

- Experience with UGC-style or faceless content formats



WHAT WE OFFER

- Creative freedom to test new ideas, with clear feedback based on real ad data

- Performance-based raises as your creatives prove themselves



HOW WE START: PAID TRIAL

We start with a paid trial on 2 of our playlists: Lo-Fi and Indie Rock. This lets you see how we work and lets us see your work.

- Duration: [e.g. 2 weeks]

- Deliverables: [e.g. 6 to 8 distinct ad creatives per playlist]

- Trial pay: [e.g. PHP X fixed for the full trial]



Lo-Fi calls for a calm, aesthetic, atmospheric style. Indie Rock calls for energy, attitude and raw visuals. We want to see that you can do both well.



We judge the trial on creative quality and on real ad performance. If it's a good match, you'll take over video content for our other playlists (Hip-Hop, Neoclassical, Soul & R&B and more) and move to a long-term role.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

1. Links to 3 to 5 short-form videos you created (ads preferred)

2. The AI tools you use and what you use each one for

3. In 3 to 5 sentences: how has Meta Andromeda changed the way you would build ad creatives for a new campaign?

4. Your expected monthly rate and available hours

5. A rough idea for one ad that would make an independent Lo-Fi or Indie Rock artist want to submit their song to a playlist



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short paid test task. The best candidate then moves on to the paid trial with our Lo-Fi and Indie Rock playlists.
